    function QuickMenu({ anchor, items, label, onClose }) {
      const menuRef = React.useRef(null);
      const dismiss = (returnFocus = false) => {
        if (returnFocus && anchor.trigger.isConnected) anchor.trigger.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        onClose();
      };
      React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const node = menuRef.current;
        if (!node) return undefined;
        node.showPopover?.();
        const width = node.offsetWidth;
        const height = node.offsetHeight;
        const scope = anchor.trigger.closest(".sk-drawer, .sk-page")?.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scopeLeft = Math.max(8, (scope?.left ?? 0) + 8);
        const scopeRight = Math.min(window.innerWidth, scope?.right ?? window.innerWidth) - width - 8;
        const right = scopeRight >= scopeLeft ? scopeRight : window.innerWidth - width - 8;
        const bottom = window.innerHeight - height - 8;
        const left = anchor.x > right ? Math.min(anchor.right - width, right) : anchor.x;
        const top = anchor.y > bottom ? Math.min(anchor.above - height, bottom) : anchor.y;
        node.style.left = `${Math.max(scopeRight >= scopeLeft ? scopeLeft : 8, left)}px`;
        node.style.top = `${Math.max(8, top)}px`;
        node.querySelector("button:not([disabled])")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        return () => node.hidePopover?.();
      }, [anchor]);
      React.useEffect(() => {
        const outside = (event) => {
          if (!menuRef.current?.contains(event.target) && !anchor.trigger.contains(event.target)) dismiss();
        };
        const scroll = (event) => {
          if (!(event.target instanceof Node && menuRef.current?.contains(event.target))) dismiss();
        };
        document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
        window.addEventListener("scroll", scroll, true);
        window.addEventListener("resize", onClose);
        return () => {
          document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside, true);
          window.removeEventListener("scroll", scroll, true);
          window.removeEventListener("resize", onClose);
        };
      }, [anchor, onClose]);

      const onKeyDown = (event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          dismiss(true);
          return;
        }
        if (event.key === "Tab") {
          event.stopPropagation();
          const dialog = anchor.trigger.closest('[aria-modal="true"]');
          if (!dialog) {
            dismiss(true);
            return;
          }
          event.preventDefault();
          const items = focusableIn(dialog);
          const index = items.indexOf(anchor.trigger);
          const direction = event.shiftKey ? -1 : 1;
          items[(index + direction + items.length) % items.length]?.focus();
          dismiss();
          return;
        }
        const buttons = [...menuRef.current.querySelectorAll("button:not([disabled])")];
        const current = buttons.indexOf(event.target);
        const target = {
          ArrowDown: (current + 1) % buttons.length,
          ArrowUp: (current + buttons.length - 1) % buttons.length,
          Home: 0,
          End: buttons.length - 1,
        }[event.key];
        if (target === undefined) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        buttons[target]?.focus();
      };

      return h("div", { ref: menuRef, popover: "manual", className: "sk-menu sk-quick-menu", role: "menu", "aria-label": label, onKeyDown,
        onContextMenu: (event) => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); } },
        items.filter(Boolean).map((item, index) => item === "divider"
          ? h("div", { key: `divider${index}`, className: "sk-menu-sep", role: "separator" })
          : h("button", { key: item.id || item.label, type: "button", role: "menuitem", tabIndex: -1, disabled: item.disabled,
              className: cx("sk-menu-item", item.danger && "is-danger"), onClick: () => {
                if (!item.keepOpen) dismiss(true);
                item.run();
              } },
              item.icon ? h(Icon, { name: item.icon, size: 14 }) : null, item.label)));
    }

    async function copyWithToast(value, label, pushToast) {
      const ok = await copyToClipboard(value);

    function taskHierarchy(tasks) {
      const present = new Set(tasks.map((task) => task.id));
      const children = new Map();
      const roots = [];
      for (const task of tasks) {
        const parentId = task.relations?.find((link) => link.type === "parent")?.taskId;
        if (present.has(parentId)) {
          if (!children.has(parentId)) children.set(parentId, []);
          children.get(parentId).push(task);
        } else {
          roots.push(task);
        }
      }
      const groups = new Map();
      const seen = new Set();
      for (const root of [...roots, ...tasks]) {
        if (seen.has(root.id)) continue;
        const workspaceId = root.workspaceId || "";
        if (!groups.has(workspaceId)) groups.set(workspaceId, { title: root.workspaceTitle || t("未分组"), rows: [] });
        const stack = [[root, 0]];
        while (stack.length) {
          const [task, depth] = stack.pop();
          if (seen.has(task.id)) continue;
          seen.add(task.id);
          groups.get(workspaceId).rows.push({ task, depth });
          for (const child of (children.get(task.id) || []).slice().reverse()) stack.push([child, depth + 1]);
        }
      }
      return groups;
    }

    function TaskCollection({ mode, tasks, projects = [], signals, onOpen, taskActions, openSession, reload, pushToast, emptyText, onClear, clearLabel }) {
      const [checked, setChecked] = React.useState([]);
      const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
      const [priority, setPriority] = React.useState("");
      const [project, setProject] = React.useState("");
      const sorted = React.useMemo(() => {
        if (mode === "schedule") return tasks;
        if (mode !== "attention") return tasks.slice().sort(compareTasks);
        return tasks.filter((task) => signals.has(task.id))
          .sort((a, b) => signals.get(a.id).rank - signals.get(b.id).rank || compareTasks(a, b));
      }, [tasks, mode, signals]);
      const active = sorted.filter((task) => checked.includes(task.id)).map((task) => task.id);
      const batch = async (patch) => {
        setBusy(true);
        try {
          const result = await command("task.batch", { ids: active, ...patch });
          pushToast(t("已更新 {0} 项任务", [result.data.count]), "info");
          setChecked([]);
          setPriority("");
          setProject("");
          await reload(true);
        } catch (cause) {
          pushToast(cause.message, "error");
        } finally {
          setBusy(false);
        }
      };

      const row = (task, depth = 0) => {
        const signal = signals.get(task.id);
        const pending = mode === "attention" ? task.pendingSessions || [] : [];
        const summary = pending.length ? null : signal
          ? [signal.label, signal.text].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")
          : task.nextSteps?.[0] || goalInfoOf(task)?.text;
        return h("li", { key: task.id, className: cx("sk-task-row", pending.length > 0 && "has-session-actions"),
          style: { "--sk-depth": Math.min(depth, 5) }, ...taskActions.handlers(task) },
          mode === "list" ? h("input", {
            type: "checkbox", "aria-label": t("选择 {0}", [task.title]), checked: checked.includes(task.id),
            disabled: busy || (active.length >= 200 && !checked.includes(task.id)),
            onChange: (event) => setChecked(event.target.checked ? [...checked, task.id] : checked.filter((id) => id !== task.id)),

    const TIMELINE_HISTORY = { get create() { return t("新建任务"); }, get status() { return t("状态变化"); }, get progress() { return t("进度更新"); }, get archive() { return t("归档变更"); }, get merge() { return t("合并任务"); }, get edit() { return t("任务更新"); } };
    const TIMELINE_EVIDENCE = { get user() { return t("需求与反馈"); }, get assistant() { return t("会话进展"); }, get deliverable() { return t("交付"); }, get artifact() { return t("产物"); }, get error() { return t("问题"); }, get todo() { return t("事项进度"); } };

    function timelineEvents(tasks, range, cutoff) {
      const events = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      const inRange = (at) => at && (range === "all" || (range === "history" ? at < cutoff : at >= cutoff));
      for (const task of tasks) {
        const before = events.length;
        const historical = isHistoricalTask(task, cutoff);
        (task.history || []).forEach((item, index) => {
          const at = timeValue(item.at);
          const label = item.note === t("确认验收") ? t("已验收") : TIMELINE_HISTORY[item.kind];
          if (!label || !inRange(at) || (range === "recent" && historical && item.by === "ai")) return;
          const detail = item.kind === "status" && STATUS_META[item.to] ? STATUS_META[item.to].label :
            item.kind === "progress" && typeof item.to === "number" ? `${item.to}%` : item.note || "";
          events.push({ key: `${task.id}:history:${index}`, at, label, detail, task });
        });
        const evidence = task.evidence || [];
        const deliveries = new Set();
        let hasSourceEvent = false;
        for (const item of evidence) {
          const at = timeValue(item.time);
          const label = TIMELINE_EVIDENCE[item.kind];
          const sessionId = item.sessionId || task.primarySessionId;
          const key = JSON.stringify([sessionId || task.id, item.kind, item.seq || at, item.seq ? "" : item.text]);
          if (!label || !inRange(at)) continue;
          hasSourceEvent = true;
          if (item.kind === "deliverable" && item.seq) deliveries.add(JSON.stringify([sessionId, item.seq]));
          if (seen.has(key)) continue;
          seen.add(key);
          const detail = item.kind === "assistant" || item.kind === "user" ? item.quote || item.text : item.text;
          events.push({ key, at, label, detail, task, sessionId, sessionTitle: item.sessionTitle });
        }
        for (const artifact of artifactsOf(task)) {
          const at = timeValue(artifact.time);
          const sessionId = artifact.sessionId || task.primarySessionId;
          if (artifact.kind !== "deliverable" || !inRange(at)) continue;
          hasSourceEvent = true;
          if (deliveries.has(JSON.stringify([sessionId, artifact.seq]))) continue;
          const key = JSON.stringify([sessionId || task.id, "delivery-file", artifact.seq || at, artifact.path || artifact.name]);
          if (seen.has(key)) continue;
          seen.add(key);
          events.push({ key, at, label: t("交付"), detail: artifact.name, task, sessionId });
        }
        const at = taskActivityAt(task);
        if (events.length === before && !hasSourceEvent && inRange(at)) {
          events.push({ key: `${task.id}:activity`, at, label: t("最近活动"), detail: "", task, sessionId: task.primarySessionId });
        }
      }
      return events.sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at || a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
    }

    function floatingReview(tasks, statuses, now = Date.now(), currentSessionId = "") {

        const projected = withSessionStatus(task, statuses, now);
        // Only the review's own session hides the card. A supporting session

    /** 待审批条：一行一张卡，悬停出现对号；点卡片本体打开对应会话。 */
    function ReviewStrip({ rows, busyId, error, expanded, message, onOpen, onAccept, onExpand }) {
      const stack = React.useRef(null);
      // 标题只在真的放不下时才跑马灯：量一次内层宽度，把位移和时长写到 DOM 上。
      React.useEffect(() => {
        const root = stack.current;
        if (!root?.querySelectorAll) return undefined;
        const measure = () => {
          for (const box of root.querySelectorAll("[data-marquee]")) {
            const label = box.firstElementChild;
            if (!label) continue;
            const shift = Math.ceil(label.scrollWidth - box.clientWidth);
            box.classList.toggle("is-overflow", shift > 1);
            box.style.setProperty("--sk-marquee-shift", shift > 1 ? `-${shift}px` : "0px");
            box.style.setProperty("--sk-marquee-duration", `${Math.min(6, Math.max(1.8, shift / 34)).toFixed(2)}s`);
          }
        };
        measure();
        if (typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return undefined;
        const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
        observer.observe(root);

    async function readChatReply({ mode, input, context, reference, signal, onEvent }) {
      const response = await fetch(new URL(`${API}/chat`, document.baseURI), {
        method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin", headers: localeHeaders({ "Content-Type": "application/json" }),
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode, input, context, reference }), signal,
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        throw new Error(payload?.message || (response.status === 404 ? t("当前看板版本不支持快聊") : t("快聊连接失败")));
      }
      if (!response.body || !/^application\/x-ndjson(?:\s*;|\s*$)/i.test(response.headers.get("content-type") || "")) {
        throw new Error(t("快聊响应格式无效，请检查连接后重试"));
      }
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = "";
      let bytes = 0;
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) throw new Error(t("回答连接已断开，请重试"));
          bytes += value.byteLength;
          if (bytes > 512_000) throw new Error(t("回答超过接收上限"));
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
          const lines = buffer.split("\n");
          buffer = lines.pop();
          for (const line of lines) {
            let event;
            try {
              event = JSON.parse(line);
            } catch {
              throw new Error(t("快聊响应格式无效，请重试"));
            }
            if (event?.type === "done") return;
            if (event?.type === "error" && typeof event.message === "string") throw new Error(event.message);
            if ((event?.type === "start" && typeof event.model === "string") ||
                (event?.type === "delta" && typeof event.text === "string")) onEvent(event);
            else throw new Error(t("快聊响应格式无效，请重试"));
          }
        }
      } finally {
        await reader.cancel().catch(() => {});
        reader.releaseLock();
      }
    }

    function chatContext(turns, route) {
      const recent = [];
      let size = 0;
      for (const turn of turns.slice().reverse()) {
        // 翻译、润色等一次性模式以及未完成的回答不进入追问上下文。
        if ((turn.mode && turn.mode !== "ask") || turn.stopped) continue;
        if (!route?.ok || turn.provider !== route.provider || turn.model !== route.model) break;
        size += turn.input.length + turn.answer.length;
        if (size > 24_000 || recent.length >= 4) break;
        recent.unshift({ input: turn.input, answer: turn.answer });
      }
      return recent.length ? { provider: route.provider, model: route.model, turns: recent } : undefined;
    }

    // 与 Host 的 server/quick-chat.mjs 保持一致：问答可连续追问，其余模式每次只处理当前输入。
    const CHAT_MODES = {
      ask: { get label() { return t("问答"); }, get placeholder() { return t("问点什么…（Enter 发送）"); }, get hint() { return t("可连续追问，最近几轮问答会作为上下文。"); } },
      prompt: { get label() { return t("写提示词"); }, get placeholder() { return t("用一两句话描述想让 AI 完成的事"); }, get hint() { return t("把想法整理成可直接发给会话的任务提示词。"); } },
      explain: { get label() { return t("解释"); }, get placeholder() { return t("粘贴报错、代码或术语"); }, get hint() { return t("解释含义，并给出可能原因和下一步。"); } },
      summarize: { get label() { return t("总结"); }, get placeholder() { return t("粘贴要总结的内容"); }, get hint() { return t("先给结论，再列要点。"); } },
      polish: { get label() { return t("润色"); }, get placeholder() { return t("粘贴要润色的文字"); }, get hint() { return t("保持原意，让表达更清晰简洁。"); } },
      "translate-zh": { get label() { return t("译成中文"); }, get placeholder() { return t("粘贴要翻译的原文"); }, get hint() { return t("只翻译当前原文。"); } },
      "translate-en": { get label() { return t("译成英文"); }, get placeholder() { return t("粘贴要翻译的原文"); }, get hint() { return t("只翻译当前原文。"); } },

    /** 快聊记录只放在当前窗口的内存里：关闭弹窗不丢，刷新窗口或点「新对话」即清空，不写入磁盘。 */

    /* --------------------------- Markdown（精简） --------------------------- */

    /** 行内标记：`code`、**加粗**、*强调* 与 http(s) 链接。只生成 React 节点，不拼接 HTML。 */
    function renderInline(text, keyPrefix) {
      const nodes = [];
      const pattern = /(`[^`\n]+`)|(\*\*[^*\n]+\*\*)|(\[[^\]\n]+\]\((https?:\/\/[^\s)]+)\))|(\*[^*\s][^*\n]*\*)/g;
      let last = 0;
      let index = 0;
      for (let match = pattern.exec(text); match; match = pattern.exec(text)) {
        if (match.index > last) nodes.push(text.slice(last, match.index));
        const token = match[0];
        const key = `${keyPrefix}:${index++}`;
        if (match[1]) nodes.push(h("code", { key }, token.slice(1, -1)));
        else if (match[2]) nodes.push(h("strong", { key }, token.slice(2, -2)));
        else if (match[3]) nodes.push(h("a", { key, href: match[4], target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" }, token.slice(1, token.indexOf("](") )));
        else nodes.push(h("em", { key }, token.slice(1, -1)));
        last = match.index + token.length;
      }
      if (last < text.length) nodes.push(text.slice(last));
      return nodes;
    }

    const MD_FENCE = /^\s*```+\s*([\w+#.-]*)\s*$/;
    const MD_HEADING = /^\s{0,3}(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/;
    const MD_QUOTE = /^\s{0,3}>\s?/;
    const MD_LIST = /^(\s*)(?:([-*+])|(\d+)[.)])\s+(.*)$/;

    /** 模型回答的块级渲染：代码块、标题、引用、列表和段落；流式输出中未闭合的代码块同样可读。 */
    function markdownBlocks(source) {
      const lines = String(source || "").replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n");
      const blocks = [];
      let index = 0;
      while (index < lines.length) {
        const line = lines[index];
        const fence = line.match(MD_FENCE);
        if (fence) {
          const code = [];
          index += 1;
          while (index < lines.length && !/^\s*```+\s*$/.test(lines[index])) code.push(lines[index++]);
          index += 1;
          blocks.push({ type: "code", lang: fence[1], text: code.join("\n") });
        } else if (!line.trim()) {
          index += 1;
        } else if (MD_HEADING.test(line)) {
          const heading = line.match(MD_HEADING);
          blocks.push({ type: "heading", level: heading[1].length, text: heading[2] });
          index += 1;
        } else if (MD_QUOTE.test(line)) {
          const quote = [];
          while (index < lines.length && MD_QUOTE.test(lines[index])) quote.push(lines[index++].replace(MD_QUOTE, ""));
          blocks.push({ type: "quote", text: quote.join("\n") });
        } else if (MD_LIST.test(line)) {
          const items = [];
          while (index < lines.length) {
            const item = lines[index].match(MD_LIST);
            if (item) items.push({ marker: item[3] ? `${item[3]}.` : "•", depth: Math.min(3, Math.floor(item[1].length / 2)), text: item[4] });
            else if (items.length && /^\s{2,}\S/.test(lines[index]) && !MD_FENCE.test(lines[index])) items.at(-1).text += "\n" + lines[index].trim();
            else break;
            index += 1;
          }
          blocks.push({ type: "list", items });
        } else {
          const paragraph = [];
          while (index < lines.length && lines[index].trim() && ![MD_FENCE, MD_HEADING, MD_QUOTE, MD_LIST].some((rule) => rule.test(lines[index]))) {
            paragraph.push(lines[index++]);
          }
          blocks.push({ type: "paragraph", text: paragraph.join("\n") });
        }
      }
      return blocks;
    }

    function MarkdownLite({ text, onCopyCode }) {
      return h("div", { className: "sk-md" }, markdownBlocks(text).map((block, key) => {
        if (block.type === "code") {
          return h("div", { key, className: "sk-md-code" },
            h("div", { className: "sk-md-code-head" }, h("span", null, block.lang || t("代码")),
              onCopyCode ? h("button", { type: "button", className: "sk-text", onClick: () => onCopyCode(block.text) }, t("复制代码")) : null),
            h("pre", { tabIndex: 0 }, h("code", null, block.text)));
        }
        if (block.type === "heading") {
          return h("p", { key, className: "sk-md-heading", role: "heading", "aria-level": Math.min(6, block.level + 3) }, renderInline(block.text, key));
        }
        if (block.type === "quote") return h("blockquote", { key }, renderInline(block.text, key));
        if (block.type === "list") {
          return h("ul", { key, className: "sk-md-list" }, block.items.map((item, index) =>
            h("li", { key: index, style: item.depth ? { marginInlineStart: item.depth * 16 } : undefined },
              h("span", { className: "sk-md-marker", "aria-hidden": "true" }, item.marker), h("span", null, renderInline(item.text, `${key}:${index}`)))));
        }
        return h("p", { key }, renderInline(block.text, key));
      }));
    }

    /* ------------------------------- 快聊弹窗 ------------------------------- */

    function QuickChat({ route, modelOpen, onModel, onClose, pushToast, host, sessionId, workspaceId, seed }) {
      const session = useStore(chatStore);
      const { turns, mode, input, reference } = session;
      const [attempt, setAttempt] = React.useState(() => null);
      const [busy, setBusy] = React.useState(false);
      const [saving, setSaving] = React.useState("");
      const request = React.useRef(null);
      const dialogRef = React.useRef(null);
      const inputRef = React.useRef(null);
      const outputRef = React.useRef(null);
      const followOutput = React.useRef(true);
      const titleId = React.useId();
      const meta = CHAT_MODES[mode] || CHAT_MODES.ask;
      useDialogFocus(dialogRef, onClose);
      useBodyScrollLock();
      React.useEffect(() => {
        if (seed?.reference || seed?.mode || seed?.input) {
          patchChat({
            ...(seed.reference ? { reference: seed.reference, mode: "ask" } : {}),
            ...(Object.hasOwn(CHAT_MODES, seed.mode || "") ? { mode: seed.mode } : {}),
            ...(seed.input ? { input: String(seed.input).slice(0, CHAT_INPUT_LIMIT) } : {}),
          });
        }
        return () => {
          request.current?.abort();
          request.current = null;
        };
      }, []);
      React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const node = outputRef.current;
        if (node && followOutput.current) node.scrollTop = node.scrollHeight;
      }, [turns, attempt]);

      const focusInput = () => inputRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      const changeMode = (next) => {
        patchChat({ mode: next });
        focusInput();
      };
      const reset = () => {
        // 先解除当前请求的归属，迟到的回调才不会把已清空的记录写回来。
        const active = request.current;
        request.current = null;
        active?.abort();
        setBusy(false);
        patchChat({ turns: [], reference: null });
        setAttempt(null);
        focusInput();
      };
      const send = async (event, retry) => {
        event?.preventDefault();
        const text = (retry ? retry.input : input).trim();
        const useMode = retry ? retry.mode || "ask" : mode;
        if (request.current || !text || route?.ok === false) return;
        const controller = new AbortController();
        request.current = controller;
        followOutput.current = true;
        // 重新生成：旧回答不进入上下文，但要等新回答成功后才被替换，失败或停止时原回答保留。
        const replaces = retry?.index;
        const history = replaces === undefined ? turns : turns.slice(0, replaces);
        const context = useMode === "ask" ? chatContext(history, route) : undefined;
        const attached = useMode === "ask" ? reference : null;
        const again = { input: text, mode: useMode, index: replaces };
        let current = { mode: useMode, input: text, answer: "", status: t("正在连接模型…"), reference: attached?.title, replaces };
        const update = (patch) => {
          current = { ...current, ...patch };
          setAttempt(current);
        };
        const record = (extra) => {
          const { status: _status, error: _error, retry: _retry, replaces: _replaces, ...turn } = current;
          patchChat((state) => {
            const next = { ...turn, ...extra };
            const list = replaces === undefined || replaces >= state.turns.length ? [...state.turns, next]
              : [...state.turns.slice(0, replaces), next, ...state.turns.slice(replaces + 1)];
            // 输入框里仍是刚发出的这段文字时清空，其余情况保留用户正在写的草稿。
            return { turns: list.slice(-CHAT_TURN_LIMIT), input: !retry || state.input.trim() === text ? "" : state.input };
          });
          setAttempt(null);
        };
        const stopped = () => {
          if (replaces !== undefined) setAttempt(null);
          else if (current.answer) record({ stopped: true });
          else update({ status: t("已停止"), retry: again });
        };
        setAttempt(current);
        setBusy(true);
        focusInput();
        try {
          await readChatReply({ mode: useMode, input: text, context, reference: attached || undefined, signal: controller.signal, onEvent: (chunk) => {
            if (request.current !== controller || controller.signal.aborted) return;
            if (chunk.type === "start") update({ model: chunk.model, provider: chunk.provider, status: t("正在回答…") });
            if (chunk.type === "delta") update({ answer: current.answer + chunk.text, status: t("正在回答…") });
          } });
          if (request.current !== controller) return;
          if (controller.signal.aborted) stopped();
          else record(null);
        } catch (cause) {
          if (request.current !== controller) return;
          if (controller.signal.aborted) stopped();
          else update({ status: "", error: cause.message, retry: again });
        } finally {
          if (request.current === controller) {
            request.current = null;
            setBusy(false);
          }
        }
      };
      const stop = (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        request.current?.abort();
        focusInput();
      };
      const toSession = async (text) => {
        const target = sessionId || host?.currentSession?.();
        if (!target || !host?.placeDraft) {
          pushToast(t("请先打开一个会话，再把内容放入输入框"), "error");
          return;
        }
        setSaving("draft");
        try {
          const result = await host.placeDraft(target, text);
          if (result?.ok && result.result === "applied") {
            pushToast(t("已放入会话输入框，确认后发送"), "info");
            onClose();
          } else {
            const copied = await copyToClipboard(text);
            pushToast((result?.result === "preserved" ? t("输入框已有草稿") : t("会话输入框未就绪")) + (copied ? t("，内容已复制") : t("，请手动复制")), copied ? "info" : "error");
          }
        } finally {
          setSaving("");
        }
      };
      const toTask = async (turn) => {
        setSaving("task");

    /* ============================= error boundary ========================= */

    /**
     * 极简错误边界：插件面板任一 render 抛错时只坏这一块，不白屏整个 DSH。
     * fallback 复用页面 token / 空态样式；「重新加载」走整页刷新（无额外依赖）。
     */
    class BoardErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
      constructor(props) {
        super(props);
        this.state = { error: null };
      }

      static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
        return { error };
      }

      render() {
        if (!this.state.error) return this.props.children;
        // 浮层出错时静默退出，避免错误页盖住整个 DSH 窗口。
        if (this.props.quiet) return null;
        const message = String((this.state.error && this.state.error.message) || this.state.error || t("未知错误"));
        return h(
          "div",
          { className: "sk-page", role: "alert", "data-super-kanban": "error" },
          h(
            "div",
            { className: "sk-empty-v3", style: { marginTop: "18vh" } },
            h("p", { className: "sk-error-title" }, h(Icon, { name: "alert", size: 14 }), t("看板加载出错")),
            h("p", { className: "sk-error-detail" }, message),
            h(
              "div",
              { className: "sk-inline-actions" },
              h(
                "button",
                { type: "button", className: "sk-btn", onClick: () => window.location.reload() },
                h(Icon, { name: "refresh", size: 12 }),
                t("重新加载"),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    /* ================================ apply =============================== */

    function apply(ctx) {
      localeService = ctx.get("locale");
      ctx.effect(() => {
        const tag = ensureStyle();
        return () => tag.remove();
      }, "super-kanban: styles");
      ctx.effect(() => {
        const sync = (event) => {
          if (event.key !== PREFS_KEY && event.key !== null) return;
          prefsStore.set(readPrefs());
        };
        window.addEventListener("storage", sync);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("storage", sync);
      }, "super-kanban: preferences");

      let resourceRequest = 0;
      const hostApi = {
        openSession(sessionId) {
          try {
            const workspace = ctx.get("uiWorkspace");
            if (workspace && typeof workspace.openSession === "function") {
              workspace.openSession(sessionId);
              return true;
            }
          } catch {
            /* navigation service unavailable */
          }
          return false;
        },
        openSide() {
          let service = null;
          try {
            service = ctx.get("sidebarRight");
          } catch {
            service = null;
          }
          if (!service || typeof service.openTab !== "function") return false;

 * Super Kanban — host half entry.
 *
 * Keeps the cordis wiring thin: mounts the plugin's HTTP surface on the DSH web
 * server and hands every request to the kanban service (server/service.mjs),
 * which owns session scanning, AI analysis, storage and the board state.
 */
import { createKanbanService } from "./server/service.mjs";
import { ownerAdmission } from "./server/auth.mjs";

export const name = "super-kanban";

const API_PREFIX = "/super-kanban/api";

/** Write a small JSON error without ever throwing into the DSH web server. */
function sendJson(res, status, body) {
  try {
    if (res.headersSent) {
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(status, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(body));
  } catch {
    /* socket already closed */
  }
}

export function apply(ctx) {
  const service = createKanbanService({ ctx });

  ctx.effect(() => {
    const dispose = service.start?.();
    return () => {
      dispose?.();
      service.stop();
    };
  }, "super-kanban: service lifetime");

  ctx.inject(["connection", "webServer"], (webCtx) => {
    webCtx.effect(
      () =>
        webCtx.webServer.register({
          kind: "prefix",
          path: API_PREFIX,
          handler: async (req, res) => {
            // Owner-only: this board reads the user's private session logs.
            const admission = ownerAdmission(webCtx.connection, req);
            if (!admission.ok) {
              if (admission.error) {
                ctx.logger?.warn?.(`[super-kanban] admission failed: ${String(admission.error?.message || admission.error)}`);
              }
              sendJson(res, admission.status, { ok: false, error: "unauthorized" });
              return;
            }
            let url;
            try {
              url = new URL(req.url || "/", "http://localhost");
            } catch {
              sendJson(res, 400, { ok: false, error: "invalid-input", message: "invalid request URL" });
              return;
            }
            const route = url.pathname.slice(API_PREFIX.length) || "/";
            try {
              await service.handle(req, res, { route, url, method: req.method || "GET" });
            } catch (error) {
              ctx.logger?.warn?.(`[super-kanban] request failed: ${String(error?.message || error)}`);
              sendJson(res, 500, { ok: false, error: "internal", message: String(error?.message || error) });
            }
          },
        }),
      "super-kanban: API routes",
    );
  });
}

/**
 * Super Kanban — LLM analyzer over the DSH native model service.
 *
 * The board no longer talks to a provider endpoint itself: every analysis goes
 * through the host composition's `llm` service (`ctx.llm`), so credentials,

 *   llm.stream({ provider, model, system, messages, maxTokens, signal })
 *   - `messages` accepts request-only user input: { role:'user', content:[{type:'text',text}] }

 * resolved lazily from `ctx`, and `createLlmAnalyzer({ ctx })` never throws
 * when the service is absent (analysis then degrades to the rules engine).

import { llmOf, streamOnce, TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS } from "./native-llm.mjs";

const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;

function POLISH_SYSTEM_PROMPT() {

/**
 * Some model outputs contain a malformed evidence field like `"seq=917"`
 * instead of `"seq": 917`, or trailing commas. Repair those before giving up.
 */
function repairModelJson(text) {
  return String(text || "")
    .replace(/"seq\s*=\s*(\d+)"/g, '"seq": $1')
    .replace(/([({,]\s*)"?seq"?\s*=\s*(\d+)/g, '$1"seq": $2')
    .replace(/,?\s*"seq"\s*:\s*(\d+)\s*"(?=\s*[,}])/g, '"seq": $1')
    .replace(/,\s*([}\]])/g, "$1");
}

/** Extract the first balanced JSON object from model output. */
export function extractJsonObject(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") return null;
  let candidate = text.trim();
  const fence = candidate.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i);
  if (fence) candidate = fence[1].trim();
  const start = candidate.indexOf("{");
  if (start === -1) return null;
  const parse = (value) => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(value);
    } catch {
      try {
        return JSON.parse(repairModelJson(value));
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
  };
  const direct = parse(candidate.slice(start));
  if (direct) return direct;

  let depth = 0;
  let inString = false;
  let escaped = false;
  for (let index = start; index < candidate.length; index++) {
    const char = candidate[index];
    if (inString) {
      if (escaped) escaped = false;
      else if (char === "\\") escaped = true;
      else if (char === '"') inString = false;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === '"') inString = true;
    else if (char === "{") depth += 1;
    else if (char === "}") {
      depth -= 1;
      if (depth === 0) return parse(candidate.slice(start, index + 1));
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/** Validate the task payload shape without trusting model output. */
function validatePayload(data) {
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object") return { error: "not-an-object" };
  let tasks = [];
  if (Array.isArray(data.tasks)) tasks = data.tasks;
  else if (typeof data.title === "string") tasks = [data]; // tolerate a bare task object
  const cleaned = tasks.filter((task) => task && typeof task === "object").slice(0, 3);
  return {
    data: {
      tasks: cleaned,
      sessionSummary: typeof data.sessionSummary === "string" ? data.sessionSummary.slice(0, 300) : "",
      ignore: data.ignore === true,
    },
  };
}

/** Build the user-visible part of an analysis request. */
export function buildUserText(digest, existingTasks) {
  const relevant = Array.isArray(existingTasks) ? existingTasks.slice(0, 3) : [];
  const taskLines = relevant.length
    ? relevant.map((task) => `- ${task.id}「${String(task.title || "").slice(0, 30)}」${task.status}`).join("\n")
    : t("(无)");
  return t("会话摘要：\n{0}\n\n已有相关任务：\n{1}\n\n输出 JSON。", [digest, taskLines]);
}

/**
 * Create the board's LLM analyzer bound to the host context.
 * @param {object} options
 * @param {object} options.ctx Cordis host context (may expose `llm` / `logger`).

  }

  /* ------------------------- AI model catalog ----------------------- */

  /** 30s catalog cache + in-flight dedupe; invalidated by DSH model events. */
  let aiCatalogCache = { at: 0, data: null };
  let aiCatalogPromise = null;
  let aiCatalogGeneration = 0;
  const aiCatalogOffs = [];

  function invalidateAiCatalog() {
    aiCatalogGeneration += 1;
    aiCatalogCache = { at: 0, data: null };
    aiCatalogPromise = null;
  }

  /** Build the flat `GET /ai/models` payload (one provider failure never hides the rest). */
  async function buildAiCatalog() {
    const llm = llmService();
    const fetchedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    if (!llm) {
      return { catalogAvailable: false, providers: [], models: [], failures: [], fetchedAt };
    }
    const routes = providerRoutes(llm);
    const perProvider = await Promise.all(
      routes.map(async (route) => {
        try {
          const models = await withTimeout(llm.listModels(route.id), aiCatalogTimeoutMsValue, "catalog-timeout");
          const list = (Array.isArray(models) ? models : [])
            .filter((model) => model && typeof model.id === "string" && model.id)
            .map((model) => ({
              provider: route.id,
              id: model.id,
              name: typeof model.name === "string" && model.name ? model.name : model.id,
            }));
          return { id: route.id, name: route.name, models: list, failure: null };
        } catch (error) {
          const label = catalogErrorLabel(error);
          logWarn(`[super-kanban] ${label}`);
          return { id: route.id, name: route.name, models: [], failure: label };
        }
      }),
    );
    return {
      catalogAvailable: true,
      providers: perProvider.map((provider) => ({ id: provider.id, name: provider.name, modelCount: provider.models.length })),
      models: perProvider.flatMap((provider) => provider.models),
      failures: perProvider
        .filter((provider) => provider.failure)
        .map((provider) => ({ provider: provider.id, name: provider.name, message: provider.failure })),
      fetchedAt,
    };
  }

  async function getAiCatalog(refresh) {
    const ttl = refresh ? 2000 : AI_CATALOG_TTL_MS;
    if (aiCatalogCache.data && Date.now() - aiCatalogCache.at < ttl) return aiCatalogCache.data;
    if (aiCatalogPromise) return aiCatalogPromise;
    const generation = aiCatalogGeneration;
    const promise = buildAiCatalog();
    aiCatalogPromise = promise;
    try {
      const data = await promise;
      // Do not repopulate a cache that an event invalidated while we were listing.
      if (generation === aiCatalogGeneration) aiCatalogCache = { at: Date.now(), data };
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      // The endpoint must degrade instead of 500: report it through `failures[]`.
      const label = catalogErrorLabel(error);
      logWarn(`[super-kanban] ${label}`);
      return {
        catalogAvailable: Boolean(llmService()),
        providers: [],
        models: [],
        failures: [{ provider: "", name: "", message: label }],
        fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    } finally {
      if (aiCatalogPromise === promise) aiCatalogPromise = null;
    }
  }

  /** Subscribe to DSH catalog events when the host event bus exists. */
  function subscribeAiCatalogEvents() {
    if (typeof ctx?.on !== "function") return;
    const invalidate = () => invalidateAiCatalog();
    for (const event of ["llm/adapters-updated", "llm/models-updated"]) {
      try {
        const off = ctx.on(event, invalidate);
        if (typeof off === "function") aiCatalogOffs.push(off);
      } catch {
        /* absent event: the 30s TTL still bounds staleness */
      }
    }
  }

  for (const diagnostic of loaded.diagnostics) {
    logWarn(`[super-kanban] store: ${diagnostic.kind}: ${diagnostic.message}`);
  }
  logInfo(
    `[super-kanban] host ready · tasks=${state.tasks.length} · sessions cached=${Object.keys(cache.sessions).length}`,
  );

  /* ------------------------------ broadcast ------------------------ */

  function broadcast(event, data) {
    if (sseClients.size === 0) return;
    const payload = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
    for (const client of [...sseClients]) {
      // A client that half-closed without firing 'close' yet is dropped instead
      // of accumulating buffered payloads in memory.
      if (client.res.writableEnded || client.res.destroyed) {
        removeSseClient(client);
        continue;
      }
      // Backpressure: a tab that stopped reading but kept the socket open would
      // make Node buffer event payloads without bound. Drop it when >1MB is
      // already queued (a write that reports back-pressure on an unread socket
      // is also dropped); EventSource reconnects automatically.
      if ((Number(client.res.writableLength) || 0) > SSE_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES) {
        removeSseClient(client);
        continue;
      }
      try {
        const accepted = client.res.write(payload);
        if (accepted === false || (Number(client.res.writableLength) || 0) > SSE_MAX_BUFFER_BYTES) {
          removeSseClient(client);
        }
      } catch {
        removeSseClient(client);
      }
    }
  }

  function removeSseClient(client) {
    if (!sseClients.has(client)) return;
    sseClients.delete(client);
    clearInterval(client.heartbeat);
    try {
      client.res.end();
    } catch {
      /* response already closed */
    }
  }

  function emitChanged(reason, tasksChanged = 0) {
    broadcast("changed", { reason, tasksChanged });
  }

  function broadcastScan(force = false) {
    if (sseClients.size === 0) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    const send = () => {
      lastScanBroadcast = Date.now();
      broadcast("scan", state.scan);
    };
    if (force || now - lastScanBroadcast > 450) {
      if (scanBroadcastTimer) {
        clearTimeout(scanBroadcastTimer);
        scanBroadcastTimer = null;
      }
      send();
      return;
    }
    if (!scanBroadcastTimer) {
      scanBroadcastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        scanBroadcastTimer = null;
        send();
      }, Math.max(50, 450 - (now - lastScanBroadcast)));
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------ persistence ---------------------- */

  function persistState() {
    try {
      store.saveState(state);
      storageFailed = false;
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      storageFailed = true;
      logWarn(`[super-kanban] state write failed (${error?.code || "unknown"})`);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** Synchronous commit boundary: publish changes only after the atomic write. */
  function commitState(change, reason = "task") {
    const previous = state;
    state = structuredClone(previous);
    try {
      const result = change();
      if (!persistState()) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error(t("无法保存看板，请检查存储后重试")), { code: "storage-unavailable" });
      }
      emitChanged(reason, reason === "task" ? 1 : 0);
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      state = previous;
      throw error;
    }
  }

  function decodeBackup(payload) {
    try {
      return store.readBackup(payload.backup?.state);
    } catch (error) {
      throw badRequest(error.message);
    }
  }

  function backupHash(payload) {
    return createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(payload.backup.state)).digest("hex");
  }

  function touchTask(task, after = 0) {
    task.updatedAt = new Date(Math.max(Date.now(), (Date.parse(task.updatedAt) || 0) + 1, after + 1)).toISOString();
  }

  function touchRecoveredTask(task, recovery, after) {
    const previous = task.updatedAt;
    touchTask(task, after);
    if (typeof previous !== "string" || !previous) return;
    for (const entry of recovery) {
      if (entry.kind === "merge" && entry.beforeTarget?.id === task.id && entry.targetUpdatedAt === previous) {
        entry.targetUpdatedAt = task.updatedAt;
      }
    }
  }

  function persistCache() {
    try {
      store.saveCache(cache);
    } catch (error) {
      logWarn(`[super-kanban] failed to save session cache: ${String(error?.message || error)}`);
    }
  }

  /** Persist state at most every few seconds during a long scan. */
  function schedulePersist() {
    if (saveTimer || stopped) return;
    saveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      saveTimer = null;
      if (persistState()) persistCache();
    }, 2000);
  }

  /* ------------------------------ derived state -------------------- */

  function workspaceById(id) {
    return state.workspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === id) || null;
  }

  function boardWorkspaces() {
    const registry = source.readWorkspaceRegistry();
    if (registry.diagnostics.length) return state.workspaces;
    const cached = new Map(state.workspaces.map((workspace) => [workspace.id, workspace]));
    const excluded = new Set(state.settings.excludeWorkspaces);
    const current = registry.workspaces.map((workspace) => ({
      id: workspace.id, title: workspace.title, path: workspace.path, source: workspace.source,
      sessionCount: cached.get(workspace.id)?.sessionCount ?? workspace.sessionIds.length,
      lastActivityAt: cached.get(workspace.id)?.lastActivityAt ?? 0,
      included: !excluded.has(workspace.id),
    }));
    const registered = new Set(current.map((workspace) => workspace.id));
    return [...current, ...state.workspaces.filter((workspace) => workspace.source === "discovered" && !registered.has(workspace.id))];
  }

  function computeStats() {
    const active = state.tasks.filter((task) => !task.archived);
    const byStatus = { backlog: 0, in_progress: 0, blocked: 0, done: 0 };
    let progressSum = 0;
    let progressCount = 0;
    let issues = 0;
    let aiAnalyzed = 0;
    for (const task of active) {
      if (byStatus[task.status] !== undefined) byStatus[task.status] += 1;
      if (Number.isFinite(task.progress)) {
        progressSum += task.progress;
        progressCount += 1;
      }
      issues += Array.isArray(task.issues) ? task.issues.length : 0;
      if (task.ai && task.ai.analyzedAt) aiAnalyzed += 1;
    }
    const total = state.tasks.length;
    const archived = total - active.length;
    const now = Date.now();
    let activeSessions = 0;
    for (const entry of Object.values(cache.sessions)) {
      if (entry?.meta?.lastActivityAt && now - entry.meta.lastActivityAt < DAY) activeSessions += 1;
    }
    return {
      total,
      archived,
      byStatus,
      doneRate: active.length > 0 ? Math.round((byStatus.done / active.length) * 100) / 100 : 0,
      activeSessions,
      avgProgress: progressCount > 0 ? Math.round(progressSum / progressCount) : 0,
      aiAnalyzed,
      issues,
    };
  }

  function computeActivity(days = 14) {
    const counts = new Map();
    const now = Date.now();
    for (let offset = days - 1; offset >= 0; offset -= 1) {
      counts.set(new Date(now - offset * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10), 0);
    }
    for (const entry of Object.values(cache.sessions)) {
      const activity = entry?.meta?.activity;
      if (!activity) continue;
      for (const [day, count] of Object.entries(activity)) {
        if (counts.has(day)) counts.set(day, counts.get(day) + count);
      }
    }
    return [...counts.entries()].map(([day, count]) => ({ day, count }));
  }

  function computeWorkspaces(discoveryWorkspaces = null, sessions = null) {
    const metas = sessions || [...sessionsById.values()];
    const lastActivity = new Map();
    const mainSessionCounts = new Map();
    for (const meta of metas) {
      if (!meta.workspaceId) continue;
      const previous = lastActivity.get(meta.workspaceId) || 0;
      lastActivity.set(meta.workspaceId, Math.max(previous, meta.lastActivityAt || 0));
      if (meta.origin === "main") mainSessionCounts.set(meta.workspaceId, (mainSessionCounts.get(meta.workspaceId) || 0) + 1);
    }
    const base = discoveryWorkspaces || state.workspaces;
    const excluded = new Set(state.settings.excludeWorkspaces || []);
    return base.map((workspace) => ({
      id: workspace.id,
      title: workspace.title,
      path: workspace.path,
      sessionCount:
        discoveryWorkspaces && sessions
          ? mainSessionCounts.get(workspace.id) || 0
          : workspace.sessionCount || 0,
      included: !excluded.has(workspace.id),
      lastActivityAt: lastActivity.get(workspace.id) || workspace.lastActivityAt || 0,
      source: workspace.source || "registry",
    }));
  }

  function fileWriteOverlaps() {
    const now = Date.now();
    const cutoff = now - RECENT_WRITE_MS;
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const task of state.tasks) {
      if (task.archived) continue;
      if (task.primarySessionId) ids.add(task.primarySessionId);
      for (const session of task.sessions || []) if (session?.id) ids.add(session.id);
    }
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const id of ids) {
      const meta = cache.sessions[id]?.meta;
      if (meta?.parseError || !meta?.hasOpenTurn || !Array.isArray(meta.recentWrites)) continue;
      for (const write of meta.recentWrites) {
        if (!write?.key || !write.path || !Number.isFinite(write.at) || write.at < cutoff || write.at > now) continue;
        if (!groups.has(write.key)) groups.set(write.key, { path: write.path, sessions: [] });
        groups.get(write.key).sessions.push({ id, at: write.at, seq: write.seq });
      }
    }
    return [...groups.values()].filter((group) => group.sessions.length > 1).slice(0, 100);
  }

  function buildStatePayload() {
    return {
      ok: true,
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      tasks: textProjection.tasks(state.tasks),
      projects: state.projects,
      writeOverlaps: fileWriteOverlaps(),
      storage: { writable: !storageFailed, savedAt: state.savedAt },
      maintenance: {
        recovery: state.recovery.map((entry) => ({ id: entry.task.id, title: textProjection.text(entry.task.title), at: entry.at, kind: entry.kind })),
        ignoredSessions: state.ignoredSessions.map((id) => ({ id, title: metaForSessionId(id)?.title || id })),
        parseFailures: Object.values(cache.sessions).filter((entry) => entry?.meta?.parseError).length,
      },
      stats: computeStats(),
      activity: state.activity,
      workspaces: boardWorkspaces(),
      scan: { ...state.scan, message: textProjection.text(state.scan.message) },
      settings: state.settings,
      aiRoute: resolveAiRoute(),
      usage: state.usage,
    };
  }

  /* --------------------------- v2 helpers -------------------------- */

  function mapTurnEndKind(kind) {
    if (kind === "completed" || kind === "error") return kind;
    if (kind === "aborted" || kind === "interrupted") return "interrupted";
    return null;
  }

  function sessionContextFromMeta(meta, parsed = null) {
    if (!meta) return null;
    const todos = parsed ? source.latestTodos(parsed) : { todoTotal: 0, todoDone: 0 };
    const lastTodo = parsed?.todoSnapshots?.[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1];
    const parsedCounts = lastTodo
      ? (() => {
          const total = lastTodo.todos.length;
          const done = lastTodo.todos.filter((todo) => todo.status === "completed").length;
          return { todoTotal: total, todoDone: done };
        })()
      : null;
    const todoCounts = meta.todoCounts || { total: 0, completed: 0 };
    return {
      sessionId: meta.id,
      title: (parsed && parsed.title) || meta.title || "",
      isLive: parsed ? Boolean(parsed.isLive) : Boolean(meta.isLive),
      turnCount: parsed ? parsed.turnCount : meta.turnCount || 0,
      lastTurnEnd: mapTurnEndKind(parsed ? parsed.lastTurnEnd?.kind : meta.lastTurnEnd?.kind),
      lastActivityAt: parsed ? parsed.lastActivityAt : meta.lastActivityAt || 0,
      lastEventSeq: parsed ? parsed.lastEvent?.seq || 0 : meta.lastEventSeq || 0,
      todoTotal: parsedCounts ? parsedCounts.todoTotal : todoCounts.total || 0,
      todoDone: parsedCounts ? parsedCounts.todoDone : todoCounts.completed || 0,
    };
  }

  /** Deterministic v2 task context for one session (no LLM tokens). */
  function buildV2Context(parsed, meta, workspaceTitle) {
    return {
      sessionId: parsed.id,
      sessionTitle: parsed.title,
      timeBySeq: parsed.timeBySeq,
      workspaceId: meta?.workspaceId || null,
      workspaceTitle: workspaceTitle || meta?.workspaceTitle || null,
      workspacePath: meta?.workspacePath || null,
      artifacts: source.extractArtifacts(parsed, { workspacePath: meta?.workspacePath }),
      subtasks: source.extractSubtasks(parsed),
      sessionContext: sessionContextFromMeta(meta, parsed),
      sessionGoal: parsed.goal?.text
        ? { text: parsed.goal.text, status: parsed.goal.status || "active" }
        : meta?.goalText
          ? { text: meta.goalText, status: meta.goalStatus || "active" }
          : null,
    };
  }

  function mergeKeyFacts(primary = [], secondary = []) {
    const merged = dedupeByText([...(primary || []), ...(secondary || [])], KEYFACT_LIMIT);
    return merged.map((fact, index) => {
      // Never invent seq 0: unresolved citations stay null (UI hides them).
      const seq = positiveSeqOrNull(fact.seq);
      return {
        id: fact.id || shortId("k", `${fact.sessionId || ""}:${seq ?? "na"}:${fact.text}:${index}`),
        text: clipText(fact.text, KEYFACT_TEXT_LIMIT),
        kind: ["status", "progress", "issue", "decision", "artifact", "goal"].includes(fact.kind) ? fact.kind : "status",
        sessionId: fact.sessionId || null,
        seq,
      };
    });
  }

  function mergeSubtasks(...sources) {
    const manual = [];
    const others = [];
    for (const sourceList of sources) {
      for (const subtask of sourceList || []) {
        const text = typeof subtask?.text === "string" ? subtask.text.trim() : "";
        if (!text) continue;
        const item = {
          id: subtask.id || shortId("s", `${subtask.source || "ai"}:${text}`),
          text: clipText(text, SUBTASK_TEXT_LIMIT),
          done: subtask.done === true,
          source: ["ai", "todo", "manual"].includes(subtask.source) ? subtask.source : "ai",
          seq: positiveSeqOrNull(subtask.seq),
        };
        if (item.source === "manual") manual.push(item);
        else others.push(item);
      }
    }
    // Manual subtasks win over generated ones with the same text.
    const userItems = dedupeByText(manual, MANUAL_SUBTASK_LIMIT);
    const userTexts = new Set(userItems.map((item) => item.text));
    return [...userItems, ...dedupeByText(others.filter((item) => !userTexts.has(item.text)), SUBTASK_LIMIT)];
  }

  function mergeArtifacts(primary = [], secondary = []) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const merged = [];
    const candidates = [...(primary || []), ...(secondary || [])].sort((left, right) =>
      Number(right?.kind === "deliverable") - Number(left?.kind === "deliverable") || (right?.time || 0) - (left?.time || 0),
    );
    for (const item of candidates) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== "object") continue;
      const key = item.absPath || item.path || item.name;
      if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      merged.push({ ...item, missing: Boolean(item.absPath && !fs.existsSync(item.absPath)) });
      if (merged.length >= ARTIFACT_LIMIT) break;
    }
    return merged;
  }

  function progressFromSubtasks(subtasks) {
    if (!Array.isArray(subtasks) || subtasks.length === 0) return null;
    const done = subtasks.filter((subtask) => subtask.done).length;
    return Math.round((done / subtasks.length) * 100);
  }

  /**
   * Unfinished subtasks the user owns (source manual) or explicitly locked via
   * `lockedFields: ["subtasks"]`. These may never be auto-closed by an AI/rule
   * "done" verdict: the user's checklist is authoritative for their own work.
   */
  function trustedUnfinishedSubtasks(task) {
    if (!task || !Array.isArray(task.subtasks)) return [];
    const subtasksLocked = (task.lockedFields || []).includes("subtasks");
    return task.subtasks.filter((subtask) => !subtask.done && (subtask.source === "manual" || subtasksLocked));
  }

  /**
   * Keep a card in_progress when an AI/rule verdict says done but the user still
   * has unfinished manual (or locked) subtasks. The proposal stays visible in the
   * task history, so the user can decide to finish it from the board.
   * Returns true when the status was downgraded.
   */
  function keepInProgressForUnfinishedUserWork(task, engine) {
    if (!task || task.status !== "done") return false;
    // The user owns the status field when locked; never override their choice.
    if ((task.lockedFields || []).includes("status")) return false;
    const unfinished = trustedUnfinishedSubtasks(task);
    if (unfinished.length === 0) return false;
    const manual = unfinished.filter((subtask) => subtask.source === "manual").length;
    const reason = manual > 0 ? t("{0} 个手动子任务", [manual]) : t("{0} 个锁定的子任务", [unfinished.length]);
    const label = engine === "llm" ? "AI" : t("规则引擎");
    task.status = "in_progress";
    pushHistory(task, {
      kind: "status",
      from: "done",
      to: "in_progress",
      by: "ai",
      note: t("{0}建议完成，但仍有 {1}未完成；保持进行中，请手动确认后归档", [label, reason]),
    });
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * A task marked done must not keep unfinished *generated* subtasks (imported
   * TODO plans can be stale); close them so progress/subtask state stays
   * self-consistent. User-owned (manual) subtasks and locked subtask lists are
   * never touched automatically.
   */
  function closeSubtasksForDoneTask(task) {
    if (!task || task.status !== "done" || !Array.isArray(task.subtasks) || task.subtasks.length === 0) return false;
    if ((task.lockedFields || []).includes("subtasks")) return false;
    const closable = task.subtasks.filter((subtask) => !subtask.done && subtask.source !== "manual");
    if (closable.length === 0) return false;
    task.subtasks = task.subtasks.map((subtask) =>
      !subtask.done && subtask.source !== "manual" ? { ...subtask, done: true } : subtask,
    );
    return true;
  }

  /** User unchecked/added unfinished work on a done card → move it back to in_progress. */
  function reopenIfSubtasksUnfinished(task) {
    if (!task || task.status !== "done" || !Array.isArray(task.subtasks) || task.subtasks.length === 0) return false;
    if (!task.subtasks.some((subtask) => !subtask.done)) return false;
    task.status = "in_progress";
    task.completionBasis = null;
    task.attention = null;
    syncGoalStatus(task);
    pushHistory(task, { kind: "status", from: "done", to: "in_progress", by: "user", note: t("子任务未完成，任务回到进行中") });
    return true;
  }

  /** v2 contract: progress follows subtask completion when subtasks exist. */
  function syncProgressFromSubtasks(task) {
    if (!task || (task.lockedFields || []).includes("progress")) return false;
    const next = progressFromSubtasks(task.subtasks);
    if (next === null || task.progress === next) return false;
    task.progress = next;
    return true;
  }

  function goalObjectFor(analysis, context, status) {
    const sessionGoal = context?.sessionGoal;
    const text = clipText(sessionGoal?.text || analysis?.goalText || analysis?.goal || "", GOAL_TEXT_LIMIT);
    const doneStatus = status === "done" ? "done" : null;
    if (sessionGoal?.text) {
      return { text, status: sessionGoal.status === "done" || doneStatus === "done" ? "done" : "active", source: "session" };
    }
    return { text, status: doneStatus === "done" ? "done" : text ? "active" : "none", source: "task" };
  }

  /** goal.status must follow task.status (active/done; none when no goal text). */
  function syncGoalStatus(task) {
    if (!task || !task.goal || typeof task.goal !== "object") return false;
    const next = task.goal.text ? (task.status === "done" ? "done" : "active") : "none";
    if (task.goal.status === next) return false;
    task.goal = { ...task.goal, status: next };
    return true;
  }

  /** Keep deterministic v2 fields fresh without touching AI verdicts. */
  function refreshTaskDeterministic(task, meta, context) {
    if (!task) return false;
    let changed = false;
    if (syncTaskTitleFromSession(task, meta)) changed = true;
    const existingEntry = (task.sessions || []).find((session) => session.id === meta.id);
    const nextEntryTitle = meta.title || sessionPlaceholderTitle(meta.id);
    if (existingEntry && nextEntryTitle && existingEntry.title !== nextEntryTitle) changed = true;
    const locked = new Set(task.lockedFields || []);
    const previousSubtasks = JSON.stringify(task.subtasks || []);
    const manual = (task.subtasks || []).filter((subtask) => subtask.source === "manual");
    const mergedSubtasks = mergeSubtasks((context?.subtasks || []), (task.subtasks || []).filter((s) => s.source !== "manual"), manual);
    if (!locked.has("subtasks") && JSON.stringify(mergedSubtasks) !== previousSubtasks) {
      task.subtasks = mergedSubtasks;
      changed = true;
    }
    const artifacts = mergeArtifacts(context?.artifacts || [], task.artifacts || []);
    if (!locked.has("artifacts") && JSON.stringify(artifacts) !== JSON.stringify(task.artifacts || [])) {
      task.artifacts = artifacts;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (context?.sessionContext && (!task.sessionContext || task.primarySessionId === meta.id)) {
      const nextContext = { ...context.sessionContext };
      if (JSON.stringify(nextContext) !== JSON.stringify(task.sessionContext)) {
        task.sessionContext = nextContext;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    const attention = task.acceptanceCriteria && context?.completionBasis && trustedUnfinishedSubtasks(task).length === 0
      ? "acceptance" : context?.attention;
    if (attention !== undefined && task.status !== "done" && task.attention !== attention) {
      task.attention = attention;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (task.status === "done" && !locked.has("status") && context?.attention && !task.completionBasis) {
      task.status = "in_progress";
      if (!locked.has("progress")) task.progress = progressFromSubtasks(task.subtasks);
      task.attention = context.attention;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (context?.sessionGoal && (!task.goal || !task.goal.text)) {
      task.goal = goalObjectFor(null, context, task.status);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (closeSubtasksForDoneTask(task)) changed = true;
    if (syncProgressFromSubtasks(task)) changed = true;
    if (
      task.status === "done" &&
      !(task.lockedFields || []).includes("progress") &&
      task.progress !== 100 &&
      trustedUnfinishedSubtasks(task).length === 0
    ) {
      task.progress = 100;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (syncGoalStatus(task)) changed = true;
    if (changed) {
      attachSession(task, meta, (task.evidence || []).length);
      task.lastActivityAt = Math.max(task.lastActivityAt || 0, meta.lastActivityAt || 0);
      touchTask(task);
      truncateTask(task);
    }
    return changed;
  }

  /**
   * Meaningful-change gate (v2 token efficiency).
   * Re-judge only when: first analysis, a turn ended after the last analysis, or
   * a new user message arrived (after the cooldown). Live turns wait for their
   * end — tool-only appends never trigger an LLM call.
   */
  function shouldRunAi(meta, cachedMeta) {
    if (!cachedMeta || !cachedMeta.aiAt) return true; // first analysis
    const lastAiSeq = Number(cachedMeta.aiLastSeq) || 0;
    const lastEndSeq = Number(meta.lastTurnEnd?.seq) || 0;
    const turnEndedSince = lastEndSeq > lastAiSeq;
    const userIncreased = (meta.userCount || 0) > (cachedMeta.aiUserCount || 0);
    const intervalOk = Date.now() - (Date.parse(cachedMeta.aiAt) || 0) >= MIN_AI_INTERVAL_MS;
    if (!intervalOk) return false;
    if (meta.isLive) {
      // Same live turn: wait for the turn to finish before spending tokens.
      return turnEndedSince;
    }
    return turnEndedSince || userIncreased;
  }

  /** Very small sessions are cheap to card with rules only. */
  function isLowValueForAi(meta) {
    const userCount = meta.userCount || 0;
    const eventCount = meta.eventCount || 0;
    const signals = (meta.deliverableCount || 0) + (meta.errorCount || 0);
    return userCount < 2 && eventCount < 60 && signals === 0;
  }

  function dailyAiRemaining() {
    const usage = rolloverUsage(state.usage);
    state.usage = usage;
    return Math.max(0, (state.settings.dailyAiCallLimit || DEFAULT_SETTINGS.dailyAiCallLimit) - usage.budgetUsed);
  }

  function reserveAiUnit() {
    if (stopped || dailyAiRemaining() <= 0) return false;
    state.usage.budgetUsed += 1;
    return true;
  }

  function recordUsage({ calls = 0, tokens = 0 } = {}) {
    state.usage = rolloverUsage(state.usage);
    state.usage.calls += Math.max(0, Number(calls) || 0);
    state.usage.tokens += Math.max(0, Number(tokens) || 0);
  }

  function persistExplicitAiUsage(result) {
    if (!readAnalyzerBudget().calls) return;
    if (result.ok) recordUsage({ calls: 1, tokens: result.usage?.totalTokens || 0 });
    if (!stopped && persistState()) emitChanged("settings");
  }

  function applyAiMeta(metaId, meta, { digestBytes = 0 } = {}) {
    const entry = cache.sessions[metaId] || { sigKey: meta.sigKey, meta };
    entry.meta = {
      ...(entry.meta || meta),
      aiAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      aiLastSeq: meta.lastEventSeq || 0,
      aiUserCount: meta.userCount || 0,
      aiTurnEndKind: meta.lastTurnEnd?.kind || null,
      aiDigestBytes: digestBytes || 0,
      // A successful analysis clears the previous failure/cooldown markers so a
      // stale error can never gate the next meaningful change.
      llmError: null,
      aiErrorAt: null,
    };
    cache.sessions[metaId] = entry;
    sessionsById.set(metaId, entry.meta);
    return entry.meta;
  }

  /* ------------------------------ scan ----------------------------- */

  function findTaskBySession(sessionId) {
    if (!sessionId) return null;
    let archived = null;
    for (const task of state.tasks) {
      if (task.primarySessionId !== sessionId && !task.sessions?.some((session) => session.id === sessionId)) continue;
      if (!task.archived) return task;
      archived ||= task;
    }
    return archived;
  }

  /* ------------------------- review strip --------------------------- */

  /**
   * The task a session speaks for. An explicit primary session wins over a
   * supporting link so one conversation never pins a shared teammate's card.
   */
  function primaryTaskForSession(sessionId) {
    if (!sessionId) return null;
    let fallback = null;
    for (const task of state.tasks) {
      if (!task || task.archived) continue;
      if (task.primarySessionId === sessionId) return task;
      // Legacy cards without an explicit primary can still be adopted; a card
      // that names another session as primary never owns this session's review.
      if (!fallback && !task.primarySessionId && task.sessions?.some((session) => session?.id === sessionId)) fallback = task;
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  /**
   * Queue (or refresh) the "turn ended, awaiting approval" notice pinned above
   * the floating entry. Idempotent for the same turn; an accepted card is never
   * re-queued by a late scan of the turn the user already approved.
   */
  function markTaskReview(task, { sessionId, seq = 0, at = Date.now(), kind = "completed" } = {}) {
    if (!task || task.archived || !sessionId) return false;
    const nextSeq = Number(seq) > 0 ? Math.floor(Number(seq)) : 0;
    const previous = task.review;
    if (previous && previous.sessionId === sessionId && Number(previous.seq) === nextSeq && nextSeq > 0) return false;
    task.review = {
      at: Math.floor(Number(at) > 0 ? Number(at) : Date.now()),
      sessionId,
      seq: nextSeq,
      kind: REVIEW_KINDS.has(kind) ? kind : "completed",
    };
    touchTask(task);
    return true;
  }

  /** Clear the notice and remember the dismissed turn so the settle scan cannot re-queue it. */
  function dismissReview(task) {
    const review = task?.review;
    if (review?.sessionId) {
      const seq = Number(review.seq);
      if (seq > 0) recordReviewSeen(review.sessionId, seq);
      // A live event may land with seq 0; remember the dismissal so the
      // settle scan can record the real seq without pinning the same turn again.
      else recordReviewDeferred(review.sessionId);
    }
    if (task) task.review = null;
  }

  /** Remember the newest processed turn-end seq for one session (bounded). */
  function recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq) {
    const number = Number(seq);
    if (!sessionId || !(number > 0)) return;
    if (!(Number(state.reviewSeen[sessionId]) >= number)) state.reviewSeen[sessionId] = Math.floor(number);
    const keys = Object.keys(state.reviewSeen);
    if (keys.length > REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT) {
      for (const key of keys.slice(0, keys.length - REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT)) delete state.reviewSeen[key];
    }
  }

  /** Remember a seq-0 dismissal until the settle scan observes the real turn. */
  function recordReviewDeferred(sessionId) {
    if (!sessionId) return;
    // Wall-clock time of the dismissal, so a later turn that ends afterwards
    // can still pin even if it lands before the settle scan.
    state.reviewDeferred[sessionId] = Date.now();
    const keys = Object.keys(state.reviewDeferred);
    if (keys.length > REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT) {
      for (const key of keys.slice(0, keys.length - REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT)) delete state.reviewDeferred[key];
    }
  }

  /** Consume a deferred dismissal. Returns the dismissal timestamp, or 0. */
  function consumeReviewDeferred(sessionId) {
    if (!sessionId || !state.reviewDeferred[sessionId]) return 0;
    const at = Number(state.reviewDeferred[sessionId]) || 0;
    delete state.reviewDeferred[sessionId];
    return at;
  }

  /**
   * Scan-side turn-end bookkeeping. The first sighting of an old session only
   * seeds the ledger; a later turn-end on the same session pins a review card.
   */
  function markScanReview(meta) {
    const sessionId = meta?.id;
    const seq = Number(meta?.lastTurnEnd?.seq) || 0;
    if (!sessionId || !seq) return false;
    const firstSighting = !state.reviewSeen[sessionId];
    const seen = Number(state.reviewSeen[sessionId]) || 0;
    const fresh = Date.now() - (Number(meta.lastTurnEnd.time) || 0) <= REVIEW_FRESH_MS;
    const deferredAt = Number(state.reviewDeferred[sessionId]) || 0;
    // Observations that would not pin anyway (seed-only or already in the
    // ledger) must keep the deferred marker: an in-flight or early scan may
    // still be looking at a turn older than the one the user just dismissed.
    if (firstSighting ? !fresh : seen >= seq) {
      recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq);
      return false;
    }
    if (meta.origin === "subagent" || Number(meta.delegationDepth) > 0) {
      recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq);
      return false;
    }
    const task = primaryTaskForSession(sessionId);
    if (!task) {
      recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq);
      return false;
    }
    // This observation would pin a card. Consume a deferred dismissal only
    // here, and only skip when it is the same turn (ended at or before the
    // dismissal). A later turn that landed before this scan still pins.
    // Values <= 1 are a legacy boolean sentinel that cannot tell turns apart.
    if (deferredAt) {
      consumeReviewDeferred(sessionId);
      recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq);
      const turnTime = Number(meta.lastTurnEnd.time) || 0;
      if (deferredAt <= 1 || turnTime <= deferredAt) return false;
    } else {
      recordReviewSeen(sessionId, seq);
    }
    return markTaskReview(task, {
      sessionId,
      seq,
      at: meta.lastTurnEnd.time || Date.now(),
      kind: meta.lastTurnEnd.kind,
    });
  }

  /* --------------------- cross-session duplicate merge --------------- */

  function dedupeByText(items, limit) {
    const seen = new Set();
    const result = [];
    for (const item of items || []) {
      if (!item || typeof item.text !== "string") continue;
      const key = item.text.trim();
      if (!key || seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      result.push(item);
      if (result.length >= limit) break;
    }
    return result;
  }

  function mergeTaskInto(target, source) {
    const beforeTarget = structuredClone(target);
    const sessions = new Map((target.sessions || []).map((session) => [session.id, session]));
    for (const session of source.sessions || []) {
      if (!sessions.has(session.id)) sessions.set(session.id, session);
    }
    if (sessions.size > MAX_SESSIONS_PER_TASK) throw badRequest(t("合并后关联会话过多"));
    const subtasks = mergeSubtasks(target.subtasks, source.subtasks);
    const manualTexts = new Set([...target.subtasks, ...source.subtasks].filter((item) => item.source === "manual").map((item) => item.text));
    if (manualTexts.size > MANUAL_SUBTASK_LIMIT) throw badRequest(t("合并后手动子任务过多"));
    const acceptanceCriteria = [...new Set([target.acceptanceCriteria, source.acceptanceCriteria].filter(Boolean))].join("\n\n");
    if (acceptanceCriteria.length > ACCEPTANCE_TEXT_LIMIT) throw badRequest(t("合并后验收条件过长，请先精简验收条件"));
    if (target.projectId && source.projectId && target.projectId !== source.projectId) {
      throw badRequest(t("两张任务属于不同项目，请先调整项目归属"));
    }
    const notes = [...new Set([target.notes, source.notes].filter(Boolean))].join("\n\n");
    if (notes.length > NOTES_LIMIT) throw badRequest(t("合并后备注过长，请先精简备注"));
    target.projectId ||= source.projectId;
    target.notes = notes;
    target.dueDate = [target.dueDate, source.dueDate].filter(Boolean).sort()[0] || null;
    target.acceptanceCriteria = acceptanceCriteria;
    target.sessions = [...sessions.values()];
    target.primarySessionId ||= source.primarySessionId;
    target.sessionContext ||= source.sessionContext;
    target.goal = target.goal?.text ? target.goal : source.goal;
    target.evidence = mergeTaskEvidence(target.evidence, source.evidence);
    target.keyFacts = mergeKeyFacts(target.keyFacts, source.keyFacts);
    target.subtasks = subtasks;
    target.artifacts = mergeArtifacts(target.artifacts, source.artifacts);
    target.resolvedIssues = [...new Set([...(target.resolvedIssues || []), ...(source.resolvedIssues || [])])].slice(-50);
    const resolved = new Set(target.resolvedIssues);
    target.issues = dedupeByText([...target.issues, ...source.issues].filter((issue) =>
      issue.source === "manual" || !resolved.has(issueKey(issue))), ISSUE_LIMIT);
    target.nextSteps = [...new Set([...target.nextSteps, ...source.nextSteps])].slice(0, NEXTSTEP_LIMIT);
    target.milestones = dedupeByText([...target.milestones, ...source.milestones], MILESTONE_LIMIT);
    target.lastActivityAt = Math.max(target.lastActivityAt || 0, source.lastActivityAt || 0);
    target.origin = target.origin === "auto" ? "auto+edited" : target.origin;
    reopenIfSubtasksUnfinished(target);
    syncProgressFromSubtasks(target);
    syncGoalStatus(target);
    refreshSessionEvidenceCounts(target);
    touchTask(target);
    pushHistory(target, { kind: "merge", by: "user", note: t("合并任务：{0}", [source.title]) });
    state.recovery.push({
      task: source,
      kind: "merge",
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      beforeTarget,
      targetUpdatedAt: target.updatedAt,
    });
    state.tasks = state.tasks.filter((task) => task.id !== source.id);
    return target;
  }

  function sessionPlaceholderTitle(sessionId) {
    return t("会话 {0}", [String(sessionId || "").slice(-6)]);
  }

  function clippedTitleVariants(title) {
    const raw = typeof title === "string" ? title.trim() : "";
    if (!raw) return [];
    return [...new Set([raw, clipText(raw, 40), clipText(raw, 48), clipText(raw, TITLE_TEXT_LIMIT)])];
  }

  function titlesAlign(left, right) {
    if (!left || !right) return false;
    const rightSet = new Set(clippedTitleVariants(right));
    return clippedTitleVariants(left).some((item) => rightSet.has(item));
  }

  function isSourceSessionForTask(task, sessionId) {
    if (!task || !sessionId) return false;
    if (task.primarySessionId) return task.primarySessionId === sessionId;
    return task.sessions?.[0]?.id === sessionId;
  }

  function lastAppliedSessionTitle(task, sessionId) {
    const entry = (task.sessions || []).find((session) => session.id === sessionId);
    return typeof entry?.title === "string" ? entry.title.trim() : "";
  }

  /**
   * True when the card is still showing a scanner placeholder or the last
   * session-derived title. A title the user (or an older client) set to
   * something else is left alone. Manual tasks and locked titles never qualify.
   */
  function isAutoTrackedTitle(task, sessionId) {
    const current = typeof task.title === "string" ? task.title.trim() : "";
    if (!current) return true;
    if (current === sessionPlaceholderTitle(sessionId)) return true;
    const last = lastAppliedSessionTitle(task, sessionId);
    return Boolean(last) && titlesAlign(current, last);
  }

  function canFollowSessionTitle(task, sessionId) {
    if (!task || task.origin === "manual") return false;
    if ((task.lockedFields || []).includes("title")) return false;
    if (!isSourceSessionForTask(task, sessionId)) return false;
    return isAutoTrackedTitle(task, sessionId);
  }

  function canAnalysisUpdateTitle(task, meta, options = {}) {
    if (!task) return false;
    if ((task.lockedFields || []).includes("title")) return false;
    if (!isSourceSessionForTask(task, meta?.id)) return false;
    // An explicit re-judge (task.analyze) may update a manual card's title,
    // matching the existing locked-field exception for options.explicit.
    if (options.explicit) return true;
    if (task.origin === "manual") return false;
    if (task.origin === "auto") return true;
    return isAutoTrackedTitle(task, meta.id);
  }

  function syncTaskTitleFromSession(task, meta) {
    if (!task || !meta) return false;
    const next = clipText(meta.title || "", TITLE_TEXT_LIMIT);
    if (!next || task.title === next) return false;
    if (!canFollowSessionTitle(task, meta.id)) return false;
    task.title = next;
    return true;
  }

  function sessionEntryFromMeta(meta, evidenceCount = 0) {
    return {
      id: meta.id,
      title: meta.title || t("会话 {0}", [String(meta.id).slice(-6)]),
      seqEnd: meta.lastEventSeq || 0,
      evidenceCount,
    };
  }

  function isEligibleForAutoTask(meta, cutoff) {
    if (meta.origin !== "main") return false;
    if (!meta.hasUserMessages) return false;
    if (state.ignoredSessions.includes(meta.id)) return false;
    if (state.suppressedSessions.includes(meta.id)) return false;
    if (meta.workspaceId && (state.settings.excludeWorkspaces || []).includes(meta.workspaceId)) return false;
    const activityAt = Number(meta.lastActivityAt) || 0;
    return !activityAt || activityAt >= cutoff || source.sessionLiveness(meta);
  }

  function activeCutoff() {
    return Date.now() - state.settings.initialDays * DAY;
  }

  function promptCandidateTasks(meta) {
    const bound = findTaskBySession(meta.id);
    const cutoff = activeCutoff();
    const recent = meta.workspaceId ? state.tasks
      .filter((task) => task !== bound && !task.archived && task.origin !== "manual" &&
        task.workspaceId === meta.workspaceId && task.lastActivityAt >= cutoff)
      .sort((left, right) => right.lastActivityAt - left.lastActivityAt) : [];
    const result = bound ? [bound, ...recent.slice(0, 2)] : recent.slice(0, 3);
    return result.map((task) => ({
      id: task.id,
      title: task.title,
      status: task.status,
      progress: task.progress,
      sessions: task.sessions,
    }));
  }

  /** Build the compact meta object persisted in sessions-cache.json. */
  function cacheEntryFor(parsed, discovered) {
    const meta = source.metaFromParsed(parsed);
    const previous = cache.sessions[meta.id]?.meta || null;
    meta.workspaceId = discovered?.workspaceId ?? previous?.workspaceId ?? null;
    meta.workspaceTitle = discovered?.workspaceTitle ?? previous?.workspaceTitle ?? null;
    meta.workspacePath = discovered?.workspacePath ?? previous?.workspacePath ?? null;
