/**
 * @typedef {Object} SessionMeta
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} file
 * @property {string} dir
 * @property {{size:number, mtimeMs:number}} sig
 * @property {string} sigKey   `${size}:${mtimeMs}`
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {number} createdAt
 * @property {string} cwd
 * @property {string|null} parentSession
 * @property {number} delegationDepth
 * @property {"main"|"subagent"} origin
 * @property {number} lastActivityAt
 * @property {number} eventCount
 * @property {number} turnCount
 * @property {boolean} isLive
 * @property {string|null} workspaceId
 * @property {string|null} workspaceTitle
 * @property {string|null} workspacePath
 * @property {{badLines:number, error?:string}} diagnostics
 */


/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Deterministic extraction (v2 — no LLM tokens)                       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export const LOCAL_SUBTASK_LIMIT = 12;
export const LOCAL_ARTIFACT_LIMIT = 6;
const DIGEST_MAX_BYTES = 1500;

function parseToolArgs(call) {
  try {
    const args = JSON.parse(call.args || "{}");
    return args && typeof args === "object" ? args : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** Workspace-relative paths use "/" on every platform so cards, digests and matching read the same on Windows. */
function posixPath(relative) {
  return path.sep === "/" ? relative : relative.split(path.sep).join("/");
}

function resolveArtifactPath(rawPath, workspaceRoot, fallbackRoot) {
  if (typeof rawPath !== "string") return null;
  const trimmed = rawPath.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > 400) return null;
  const root = workspaceRoot || fallbackRoot || null;
  try {
    if (path.isAbsolute(trimmed)) return path.resolve(trimmed);
    return root ? path.resolve(root, trimmed) : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Artifacts = deliverable files + write/edit tool targets (deduped).
 * Relative to the workspace when possible; deterministic, zero tokens.
 */
export function extractArtifacts(parsed, { workspacePath = null, max = LOCAL_ARTIFACT_LIMIT } = {}) {
  const workspaceRoot = workspacePath
    ? path.resolve(workspacePath)
    : parsed?.session?.cwd
      ? path.resolve(parsed.session.cwd)
      : null;
  const candidates = [];
  const failedCalls = new Set((parsed.toolResults || []).filter((item) => item.isError && item.toolCallId).map((item) => item.toolCallId));
  for (const item of parsed.deliverables || []) {
    for (const file of item.files || []) {
      const cwd = item.cwd && item.cwd !== parsed.session?.cwd ? item.cwd : workspaceRoot;
      const absPath = resolveArtifactPath(file.path, cwd);
      if (!absPath) continue;
      candidates.push({ absPath, seq: item.seq, time: item.time, description: file.description || "", priority: 0 });
    }
  }
  for (const call of parsed.toolCalls || []) {
    if (call.name !== "write" && call.name !== "edit") continue;
    if (failedCalls.has(call.callId)) continue;
    const args = parseToolArgs(call);
    const absPath = resolveArtifactPath(
      args.path || args.file_path || args.filePath || args.file,
      call.cwd && call.cwd !== parsed.session?.cwd ? call.cwd : workspaceRoot,
    );
    if (!absPath) continue;
    candidates.push({ absPath, seq: call.seq, time: call.time, description: "", priority: 1 });
  }
  candidates.sort((left, right) => left.priority - right.priority || right.seq - left.seq);
  const seen = new Set();
  const chosen = [];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (chosen.length >= max) break;
    if (seen.has(candidate.absPath)) continue;
    // Only advertise artifacts that still exist on disk (DSH preview must open).
    try {
      if (!fs.existsSync(candidate.absPath)) continue;
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    seen.add(candidate.absPath);
    chosen.push(candidate);
  }
  return chosen.map((candidate) => ({
    id: `a_${shortHash(`${parsed.id}:${candidate.absPath}`)}`,
    name: path.basename(candidate.absPath),
    path:
      workspaceRoot && candidate.absPath.startsWith(workspaceRoot + path.sep)
        ? posixPath(path.relative(workspaceRoot, candidate.absPath))
        : candidate.absPath,
    absPath: candidate.absPath,
    sessionId: parsed.id,
    seq: candidate.seq,
    time: candidate.time,
    description: clip(candidate.description, 120),
    kind: candidate.priority === 0 ? "deliverable" : "modified",
  }));
}

function gitWorktreeRoot(cwd) {
  for (let current = fs.realpathSync(cwd); ; current = path.dirname(current)) {
    const marker = path.join(current, ".git");
    const stat = fs.statSync(marker, { throwIfNoEntry: false });
    if (stat) {
      let gitDir = marker;
      if (stat.isFile() && stat.size <= 4096) {
        const target = /^gitdir: (.+)$/m.exec(fs.readFileSync(marker, "utf8"))?.[1]?.trim();
        if (!target) return null;
        gitDir = path.resolve(current, target);
      } else if (!stat.isDirectory()) return null;
      return fs.statSync(path.join(gitDir, "HEAD"), { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isFile() ? current : null;
    }
    if (path.dirname(current) === current) return null;
  }
}

/** Positive evidence only: successful write/edit operations from the current open turn. */
function recentWritesOf(parsed, now) {
  if (!parsed.hasOpenTurn) return [];
  const turnStart = parsed.turnStarts.at(-1)?.seq;
  if (!turnStart) return [];
  const cutoff = now - RECENT_WRITE_MS;
  const results = new Map(parsed.toolResults.filter((item) => item.seq > turnStart && item.toolCallId).map((item) => [item.toolCallId, item]));
  const roots = new Map();
  const writes = new Map();
  for (let index = parsed.toolCalls.length - 1; index >= 0 && writes.size < 12; index--) {
    const call = parsed.toolCalls[index];
    if (call.seq <= turnStart) break;
    if (!call.cwd || !["write", "edit"].includes(call.name)) continue;
    const result = results.get(call.callId);
    if (!result || result.isError || result.seq <= call.seq || result.time < cutoff || result.time > now) continue;
    const args = parseToolArgs(call);
    const target = resolveArtifactPath(args.path || args.file_path || args.filePath || args.file, call.cwd);
    if (!target) continue;
    try {
      if (!roots.has(call.cwd)) roots.set(call.cwd, gitWorktreeRoot(call.cwd));
      const root = roots.get(call.cwd);
      if (!root) continue;
      const file = fs.realpathSync(target);
      const relative = path.relative(root, file);
      if (!relative || relative === ".." || relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(relative) || !fs.statSync(file).isFile()) continue;
      const key = shortHash(`${root}\0${file}`, 24);
      if (!writes.has(key)) writes.set(key, { key, path: posixPath(relative), seq: result.seq, at: result.time });
    } catch { /* missing or inaccessible checkout evidence is omitted */ }
  }
  return [...writes.values()];
}

/**
 * Latest todo snapshot → subtasks. A snapshot written before the current turn
 * started is stale (the plan often changes); import it only when fully done.
 * `forceAll` powers the manual task.importTodos op.
 */
export function extractSubtasks(parsed, { max = LOCAL_SUBTASK_LIMIT, forceAll = false } = {}) {
  const last = parsed.todoSnapshots?.[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1];
  if (!last) return [];
  const lastTurnStartSeq = parsed.turnStarts?.[parsed.turnStarts.length - 1]?.seq ?? 0;
  const fresh = last.seq > lastTurnStartSeq;
  const allDone = last.todos.every((todo) => todo.status === "completed");
  if (!forceAll && !fresh && !allDone) return [];
  return last.todos.slice(0, max).map((todo, index) => ({
    id: `s_${shortHash(`${parsed.id}:todo:${last.seq}:${index}`)}`,
    text: clip(todo.content, 40),
    done: todo.status === "completed",
    source: "todo",
    seq: last.seq,
  }));
}

export function latestTodos(parsed) {
  const last = parsed.todoSnapshots?.[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1];
  const todos = last ? last.todos.map((todo) => ({ content: clip(todo.content, 80), status: todo.status })) : [];
  return { todos, todoTotal: todos.length, todoDone: todos.filter((todo) => todo.status === "completed").length };
}

/** Files written/edited + tool names since `baselineSeq` (digest tool summary). */
export function toolBrief(parsed, { baselineSeq = 0, workspacePath = null } = {}) {
  const workspaceRoot = workspacePath
    ? path.resolve(workspacePath)
    : parsed?.session?.cwd
      ? path.resolve(parsed.session.cwd)
      : null;
  const files = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const call of parsed.toolCalls || []) {
    if (call.seq <= baselineSeq) continue;
    if (call.name !== "write" && call.name !== "edit") continue;
    const args = parseToolArgs(call);
    const absPath = resolveArtifactPath(
      args.path || args.file_path || args.filePath || args.file,
      workspaceRoot,
      parsed.session?.cwd,
    );
    if (!absPath) continue;
    const relative =
      workspaceRoot && absPath.startsWith(workspaceRoot + path.sep) ? posixPath(path.relative(workspaceRoot, absPath)) : absPath;
    if (seen.has(relative)) continue;
    seen.add(relative);
    files.push(clip(relative, 80));
    if (files.length >= 8) break;
  }
  const names = [];
  for (const call of parsed.toolCalls || []) {
    if (call.seq <= baselineSeq) continue;
    if (!names.includes(call.name)) names.push(call.name);
    if (names.length >= 8) break;
  }
  return { files, commandNames: names.slice(0, 5) };
}

/**
 * Compact v2 digest (≤1.5KB UTF-8 ≈ 500-700 tokens). Only recent changes:
 * users/assistant tail, latest todos, tool/error summary since `baselineSeq`,
 * plus the bound task summary for mergeWith decisions.
 */
export function buildDigest(
  parsed,
  { workspaceTitle = null, existingTasks = [], baselineSeq = 0, maxBytes = DIGEST_MAX_BYTES } = {},
) {
  const byteLen = (value) => Buffer.byteLength(value, "utf8");
  const pieces = [];
  const budget = maxBytes;
  let used = 0;
  /** Append a line if it fits (clipped to the remaining room when close). */
  const add = (label, value, maxItemChars = 240) => {
    const text = String(value || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    if (!text) return false;
    const line = label ? `${label}${clip(text, maxItemChars)}` : clip(text, maxItemChars);
    const size = byteLen(line) + 1;
    if (used + size <= budget) {
      pieces.push(line);
      used += size;
      return true;
    }
    const room = budget - used - 1;
    if (room > 120) {
      // Clip by characters (UTF-8 CJK ≈3 bytes) until it fits.
      let cut = Math.floor(room / 3);
      let candidate = `${label}${text.slice(0, Math.max(20, cut))}…`;
      while (byteLen(candidate) > room && cut > 20) {
        cut -= 10;
        candidate = `${label}${text.slice(0, cut)}…`;
      }
      if (byteLen(candidate) <= room) {
        pieces.push(candidate);
        used += byteLen(candidate) + 1;
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  };

  const endKind = parsed.lastTurnEnd?.kind || "none";
  const goal = parsed.goal?.text ? t(" | 目标:{0}", [clip(parsed.goal.text, 60)]) : "";
  add(
    "",
    t("会话:{0} | 工作区:{1} | live:{2} | turns:{3} | end:{4}{5}", [clip(parsed.title, 36), workspaceTitle || "?", parsed.isLive ? 1 : 0, parsed.turnCount, endKind, goal]),
    260,
  );
  const bound = (Array.isArray(existingTasks) ? existingTasks : [])
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map((task) => `${task.id}「${clip(task.title, 24)}」${task.status}`);
  if (bound.length) add(t("已有任务:"), bound.join("；"), 160);

  // Recent-change priority: latest user instruction, latest assistant summary,
  // then todos/errors/tools, then older context.
  const latestUser = [...(parsed.users || [])].reverse().find((message) => message.seq > baselineSeq) || parsed.users?.at(-1);
  if (latestUser) add(`U[${latestUser.seq}] `, latestUser.text, 200);
  const latestAssistant = parsed.assistants?.at(-1);
  if (latestAssistant) add(`A[${latestAssistant.seq}] `, latestAssistant.text, 200);

  const lastTodo = parsed.todoSnapshots?.[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1];
  if (lastTodo) {
    const mark = (status) => (status === "completed" ? "[x]" : status === "in_progress" ? "[~]" : "[ ]");
    add(
      t("待办:"),
      lastTodo.todos
        .slice(0, 6)
        .map((todo) => `${mark(todo.status)}${clip(todo.content, 24)}`)
        .join(" "),
      300,
    );
  }
  const errors = (parsed.errors || []).filter((error) => error.seq > baselineSeq).slice(-2);
  if (errors.length) add(t("错误:"), errors.map((error) => `[${error.seq}] ${clip(error.text.replace(/\s+/g, " "), 90)}`).join(" "), 260);
  const brief = toolBrief(parsed, { baselineSeq, workspacePath: parsed.session?.cwd });
  const toolParts = [];
  if (brief.files.length) toolParts.push(t("写入:{0}", [brief.files.slice(0, 5).join(",")]));
  if (brief.commandNames.length) toolParts.push(t("工具:{0}", [brief.commandNames.join(",")]));
  if (toolParts.length) add("", toolParts.join(" | "), 220);

  // Fill remaining room with older context (never sacrifices the sections above).
  const olderUser = [...(parsed.users || [])].reverse().find((message) => message !== latestUser);
  if (olderUser) add(`U[${olderUser.seq}] `, olderUser.text, 120);
  const previousAssistant = parsed.assistants?.length > 1 ? parsed.assistants[parsed.assistants.length - 2] : null;
  if (previousAssistant && previousAssistant !== latestAssistant) add(`A[${previousAssistant.seq}] `, previousAssistant.text, 120);

  return pieces.join("\n");
}

export function createSessionSource({ dshHome } = {}) {
  if (!dshHome) throw new Error("createSessionSource requires dshHome");
  const home = dshHome;
  const sessionsRoot = path.join(home, "sessions");
  /**
   * file path -> { sigKey, actualSig, parsed }. Map iteration order is the LRU
   * order: reading an entry re-inserts it at the end, writing evicts the front.
   * Entries are only stored for successfully parsed logs.
   */
  const parsedCache = new Map();
  let workspaceRegistryCache = null;

  function readWorkspaceRegistry() {
    const file = path.join(home, "storages", "workspace.json");
    const diagnostics = [];
    let registry = { workspaces: [], sessionWorkspace: new Map() };
    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(file);
      const signature = `${stat.ino}:${stat.mtimeMs}:${stat.size}`;
      if (workspaceRegistryCache?.signature === signature) return workspaceRegistryCache.value;
      const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
      if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw) || !raw.tables || typeof raw.tables !== "object") {
        diagnostics.push({ kind: "workspace-registry", message: "workspace.json has an unexpected shape" });
        return { workspaces: [], sessionWorkspace: new Map(), diagnostics };
      }
      const table = raw.tables.workspaces && typeof raw.tables.workspaces === "object" ? raw.tables.workspaces : {};
      const order = Array.isArray(raw.global?.workspaceIds) ? new Set(raw.global.workspaceIds) : Object.keys(table);
      const workspaces = [];
      const sessionWorkspace = new Map();
      for (const id of order) {
        if (typeof id !== "string" || !Object.hasOwn(table, id)) continue;
        const entry = table[id];
        if (!entry || typeof entry.path !== "string" || !entry.path) continue;
        const workspace = {
          id,
          title: entry.title || basenameOf(entry.path),
          path: entry.path,
          sessionIds: Array.isArray(entry.sessionIds) ? entry.sessionIds : [],
          createdAt: Date.parse(entry.createdAt || "") || 0,
          updatedAt: Date.parse(entry.updatedAt || "") || 0,
          source: "registry",
        };
        workspaces.push(workspace);
        for (const sessionId of workspace.sessionIds) sessionWorkspace.set(sessionId, workspace);
      }
      registry = { workspaces, sessionWorkspace };
      workspaceRegistryCache = { signature, value: { ...registry, diagnostics } };
    } catch (error) {
      diagnostics.push({
        kind: "workspace-registry",
        message: error?.code === "ENOENT" ? "workspace.json not found" : String(error?.message || error),
      });
    }
    return { ...registry, diagnostics };
  }

  /**
   * DSH Session Goal lives in projcache `rows.goal.val.current` and may be
   * null. Accept string or {objective|description|text, status} shapes.
   */
  function parseProjcacheGoal(rows) {
    const current = rows?.goal?.val?.current;
    if (!current) return { text: null, status: null };
    const text =
      typeof current === "string"
        ? current
        : current.objective || current.description || current.text || current.goal || current.summary || "";
    const clean = typeof text === "string" ? text.trim() : "";
    if (!clean) return { text: null, status: null };
    const rawStatus = current.status || current.state;
    const done = rawStatus === "done" || rawStatus === "completed" || current.done === true;
    return { text: clean, status: done ? "done" : "active" };
  }

  function readProjcache(sessionId) {
    const file = path.join(home, ...PROJCACHE_DIR, `${sessionId}.json`);
    try {
      const raw = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
      const record = raw?.record || {};
      const rows = record.rows || {};
      const catalogValues = rows.subagentCatalog?.val?.head?.values;
      const teamMembers = rows.agentTeam?.val?.members;
      const children = new Set();
      if (Array.isArray(catalogValues)) {
        for (const child of catalogValues) if (child?.childId) children.add(String(child.childId));
      }
      if (Array.isArray(teamMembers)) {
        for (const member of teamMembers) if (member?.id) children.add(String(member.id));
      }
      return {
        title: typeof rows.title?.val === "string" ? rows.title.val : null,
        createdAt: Number(record.identity?.createdAt) || 0,
        cwd: typeof record.identity?.cwd === "string" ? record.identity.cwd : rows.workingDirectory?.val || null,
        turns: Number(rows.sessionStats?.val?.turns) || 0,
        turnOutline: Array.isArray(rows.turnOutline?.val?.turns) ? rows.turnOutline.val.turns : [],
        blank: rows.sessionListMetadata?.val?.blank === true,
        lastPromptAt: Number(rows.sessionListMetadata?.val?.lastPromptAt) || 0,
        lastMessageTime: Number(rows.timeContext?.val?.lastMessageTime) || 0,
        children: [...children],
        goal: parseProjcacheGoal(rows),
      };
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Walk $DSH_HOME/sessions. Cheap: only stats files and reads small projcache
   * JSON blobs — no zstd work here (that happens lazily in loadParsed).
   */
  function discover() {
    const registry = readWorkspaceRegistry();
    const diagnostics = [...registry.diagnostics];
    const discovered = [];
    let sessionDirs = [];
    try {
      sessionDirs = fs.readdirSync(sessionsRoot, { withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory());
    } catch (error) {
      diagnostics.push({
        kind: "sessions-root",
        message: error?.code === "ENOENT" ? "sessions directory not found" : String(error?.message || error),
      });
      return { workspaces: registry.workspaces.map((w) => ({ ...w })), sessions: [], diagnostics };
    }

    const projcache = new Map();
    for (const dirEntry of sessionDirs) {
      const dir = path.join(sessionsRoot, dirEntry.name);
      let names = [];
      try {
        names = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory());
      } catch {
        continue;
      }
      for (const entry of names) {
        const sessionDir = path.join(dir, entry.name);
        const file = path.join(sessionDir, SESSION_FILE_NAME);
        let stat;
        try {
          stat = fs.statSync(file);
        } catch {
          continue; // dir without a log (e.g. lock-only) — not a session
        }
        const cache = readProjcache(entry.name);
        projcache.set(entry.name, cache);
        discovered.push({
          id: entry.name,
          file,
          dir: sessionDir,
          escapedWorkspace: dirEntry.name,
          sig: { size: stat.size, mtimeMs: stat.mtimeMs },
          projcache: cache,
        });
      }
    }

    // Parent/child: DSH records spawned subagents in the parent's projcache
    // (subagentCatalog / agentTeam). Build the reverse index once.
    const childToParent = new Map();
    for (const [parentId, cache] of projcache) {
      for (const childId of cache?.children || []) {
        if (!childToParent.has(childId)) childToParent.set(childId, parentId);
      }
    }
    const depthOf = (sessionId) => {
      let depth = 0;
      let current = sessionId;
      const seen = new Set();
      while (childToParent.has(current) && depth < 8 && !seen.has(current)) {
        seen.add(current);
        current = childToParent.get(current);
        depth += 1;
      }
      return depth;
    };

    // Workspace mapping: registry session list first, then cwd, then parent.
    const byPath = new Map();
    for (const workspace of registry.workspaces) byPath.set(path.resolve(workspace.path), workspace);
    const sessionWorkspace = registry.sessionWorkspace;
    const synthetic = new Map(); // path -> workspace

    const workspaceFor = (sessionId, cwd) => {
      const registered = sessionWorkspace.get(sessionId);
      if (registered) return registered;
      if (cwd) {
        const match = byPath.get(path.resolve(cwd));
        if (match) return match;
      }
      const parentId = childToParent.get(sessionId);
      if (parentId) {
        const parentCache = projcache.get(parentId);
        const parentCwd = parentCache?.cwd;
        if (parentCwd) {
          const parentMatch = byPath.get(path.resolve(parentCwd));
          if (parentMatch) return parentMatch;
          if (synthetic.has(path.resolve(parentCwd))) return synthetic.get(path.resolve(parentCwd));
        }
      }
      if (!cwd) return null;
      const key = path.resolve(cwd);
      if (!synthetic.has(key)) {
        synthetic.set(key, {
          id: `ws_${shortHash(key, 12)}`,
          title: basenameOf(cwd),
          path: cwd,
          sessionIds: [],
          createdAt: 0,
          updatedAt: 0,
          source: "discovered",
        });
      }
      return synthetic.get(key);
    };

    /** @type {SessionMeta[]} */
    const sessions = discovered.map((item) => {
      const cache = item.projcache;
      const createdAt = cache?.createdAt || 0;
      const cwd = cache?.cwd || null;
      const parentSession = childToParent.get(item.id) || null;
      const depth = depthOf(item.id);
      const workspace = workspaceFor(item.id, cwd);
      return {
        id: item.id,
        file: item.file,
        dir: item.dir,
        sig: item.sig,
        sigKey: `${item.sig.size}:${item.sig.mtimeMs}`,
        title: cache?.title || null,
        createdAt,
        cwd,
        parentSession,
        delegationDepth: depth,
        origin: depth > 0 ? "subagent" : "main",
        lastActivityAt: cache?.lastMessageTime || 0,
        lastPromptAt: cache?.lastPromptAt || 0,
        eventCount: 0,
        turnCount: cache?.turns || 0,
        isLive: false,
        workspaceId: workspace?.id || null,
        workspaceTitle: workspace?.title || null,
        workspacePath: workspace?.path || null,
        blank: cache?.blank === true,
        goalText: cache?.goal?.text || null,
        goalStatus: cache?.goal?.status || null,
        turnOutline: cache?.turnOutline || [],
        cached: false,
        diagnostics: { badLines: 0 },
      };
    });

    // Merge synthetic workspaces into the public workspace list.
    const workspaces = [...registry.workspaces.map((workspace) => ({ ...workspace, synthetic: false }))];
    for (const candidate of synthetic.values()) workspaces.push({ ...candidate, synthetic: true });

    const byWorkspace = new Map(workspaces.map((workspace) => [workspace.id, workspace]));
    for (const session of sessions) {
      const workspace = session.workspaceId ? byWorkspace.get(session.workspaceId) : null;
      if (!workspace) continue;
      workspace.sessionIds = workspace.sessionIds || [];
      if (!workspace.sessionIds.includes(session.id)) workspace.sessionIds.push(session.id);
    }
    for (const workspace of workspaces) {
      workspace.sessionCount = sessions.filter(
        (session) => session.workspaceId === workspace.id && session.origin === "main",
      ).length;
    }
    workspaces.sort((a, b) => (b.updatedAt || 0) - (a.updatedAt || 0) || a.title.localeCompare(b.title, "zh"));
    return { workspaces, sessions, diagnostics, childToParent };
  }

  /** Current `${size}:${mtimeMs}` signature of a session file ("" when unreadable). */
  function fileSigKey(file) {
    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(file);
      return `${stat.size}:${stat.mtimeMs}`;
    } catch {
      return "";
    }
  }

  /**
   * Metadata the parser bakes into its result. Goals and lineage come from the
   * projcache or workspace registry; the session title prefers a `session/title`
   * event and only falls back to `meta.title`. Those fields can change without a
   * new session-file signature, so the cache must compare them too: otherwise a
   * parse whose fallback title or goal is stale relative to the caller's meta
   * could be reused.
   */
  function metaFingerprint(meta) {
    return JSON.stringify([
      meta?.id,
      meta?.title,
      meta?.parentSession,
      meta?.delegationDepth,
      meta?.createdAt,
      meta?.cwd,
      meta?.dir,
      meta?.goalText,
      meta?.goalStatus,
      meta?.turnOutline,
    ]);
  }

  function rememberParsed(file, sigKey, actualSig, metaKey, parsed) {
    parsedCache.delete(file);
    parsedCache.set(file, { sigKey, actualSig, metaKey, parsed });
    while (parsedCache.size > PARSED_CACHE_LIMIT) {
      // Map preserves insertion order: evict the least recently used entry.
      parsedCache.delete(parsedCache.keys().next().value);
    }
  }

  function sessionLiveness({ dir, file, hasOpenTurn, lastActivityAt }, now = Date.now()) {
    const sessionDir = dir || (file ? path.dirname(file) : null);
    if (sessionDir) {
      try {
        if (now - fs.statSync(path.join(sessionDir, "session.lock")).mtimeMs < 5 * 60_000) return true;
      } catch {
        // A session may have no active writer.
      }
    }
    return Boolean(hasOpenTurn && lastActivityAt > 0 && now - lastActivityAt < 30 * 60_000);
  }

  /**
   * Read + decompress + parse one session file (synchronous, ~10-300ms).
   *
   * A caller may hold a stale `meta` (e.g. `sessionsById` from before the last
   * file write), so a cache hit requires BOTH the caller's `sigKey` and the
   * file's current stat to match the cached entry; otherwise the file is parsed
   * again. Failures are never cached, so a corrupt log can be retried after it
   * is rewritten.
   */
  function loadParsed(meta) {
    const file = typeof meta?.file === "string" ? meta.file : "";
    const sigKey = typeof meta?.sigKey === "string" ? meta.sigKey : "";
    let actualSig = "";
    let metaKey = "";
    if (file && sigKey) {
      actualSig = fileSigKey(file);
      metaKey = metaFingerprint(meta);
      const cached = parsedCache.get(file);
      if (cached && actualSig && cached.sigKey === sigKey && cached.actualSig === actualSig && cached.metaKey === metaKey) {
        // LRU touch: re-insert so the hottest session survives eviction.
        parsedCache.delete(file);
        parsedCache.set(file, cached);
        const isLive = sessionLiveness(cached.parsed);
        return isLive === cached.parsed.isLive ? cached.parsed : { ...cached.parsed, isLive };
      }
    }
    const diagnostics = [];
    let text = "";
    try {
      text = decompressSessionBuffer(fs.readFileSync(meta.file));
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error(`decompress-failed: ${String(error?.message || error)}`);
    }
    const { events, badLines } = parseJsonlEvents(text);
    if (badLines > 0) diagnostics.push({ kind: "jsonl", badLines });
    if (events.length === 0) throw new Error("empty-session-log");
    const parsed = parseEvents(meta, events, diagnostics);
    if (file && sigKey && actualSig) rememberParsed(file, sigKey, actualSig, metaKey, parsed);
    return parsed;
  }

  /**
   * Parse raw events into the compact structure consumed by analyzers and API.
   * Unknown event types are ignored defensively; every single-session parse
   * failure is isolated by the caller (scan records diagnostics and continues).
   */
  function parseEvents(meta, events, diagnostics = []) {
    const sessionEvent = events.find((event) => event.type === "session") || {};
    // `session` events carry their payload as `{type, seq, time, data:{id,cwd,…}}`.
    // Keep a flat-event fallback for older logs written before that envelope.
    const sessionInfo = sessionEvent.data && typeof sessionEvent.data === "object" ? sessionEvent.data : sessionEvent;
    const users = [];
    const assistants = [];
    const toolCallsById = new Map();
    const toolResults = [];
    const todoSnapshots = [];
    const turnEnds = [];
    const turnStarts = [];
    const deliverables = [];
    const workspaceChanges = [];
    const errors = [];
    const signals = [];
    const systemNotices = [];
    const activity = Object.create(null);
    let title = null;
    let titleSource = null;
    let lastActivityAt = 0;
    let lastEvent = null;
    let lastAssistantText = null;
    let assistantTexts = 0;
    let turnsSeen = 0;
    let lastSeedSeq = 0;
    const initialCwd = typeof sessionInfo.cwd === "string" ? sessionInfo.cwd : meta.cwd;
    let workingDirectory = typeof initialCwd === "string" && path.isAbsolute(initialCwd) ? initialCwd : null;

    for (const event of events) {
      const data = event.data || {};
      if (event.time > lastActivityAt) lastActivityAt = event.time;
      lastEvent = event;
      const day = isoDay(event.time);
      if (day) activity[day] = (activity[day] || 0) + 1;

      switch (event.type) {
        case "session/end-seed":
          lastSeedSeq = event.seq;
          break;
        case "working-directory/change":
          workingDirectory = typeof data.cwd === "string" && path.isAbsolute(data.cwd) ? data.cwd : null;
          break;
        case "user/message": {
          const text = textOfContent(data.content).trim();
          if (!text) break;
          const sourceKind = data.source?.kind;
          if (sourceKind === undefined || sourceKind === "user") {
            users.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, text, images: countImages(data.content) });
          } else if (ASYNC_SIGNAL_KINDS.has(sourceKind)) {
            // Injected context (team mail, background-job notices, model switch…)
            // is not a user request but can explain state changes in the digest.
            signals.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, kind: sourceKind, text });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "assistant/message": {
          assistantTexts += 1;
          const text = textOfContent(data.message?.content).trim();
          if (text) {
            assistants.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, turn: Number(data.turn) || 0, text });
            lastAssistantText = { seq: event.seq, time: event.time, text };
          }
          for (const content of data.message?.content || []) {
            if (content?.type === "tool-call" && content.name && content.id && !toolCallsById.has(content.id)) {
              // The authoritative call event is `tool/call`; keep this as fallback
              // for older logs where that event was not written.
              toolCallsById.set(content.id, {
                seq: event.seq,
                time: event.time,
                name: String(content.name),
                callId: content.id,
                args: typeof content.arguments === "string" ? content.arguments : JSON.stringify(content.arguments ?? ""),
              });
            }
          }
          break;
        }
        case "tool/call": {
          if (data.name) {
            toolCallsById.set(data.callId || `seq:${event.seq}`, {
              seq: event.seq,
              time: event.time,
              name: String(data.name),
              callId: data.callId || null,
              cwd: workingDirectory,
              args: typeof data.arguments === "string" ? data.arguments : JSON.stringify(data.arguments ?? ""),
            });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "tool/result": {
          const isError = data.message?.isError === true || Boolean(data.error);
          const text = textOfContent(data.message?.content);
          toolResults.push({
            seq: event.seq,
            time: event.time,
            isError,
            text,
            toolCallId: data.toolCallId || data.message?.source?.callId || null,
          });
          if (isError) errors.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, source: "tool", text });
          break;
        }
        case "todo/write": {
          if (Array.isArray(data.todos)) {
            todoSnapshots.push({
              seq: event.seq,
              time: event.time,
              todos: data.todos
                .filter((todo) => todo && typeof todo.content === "string")
                .map((todo) => ({ content: todo.content, status: String(todo.status || "pending") })),
            });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "turn/start": {
          turnsSeen += 1;
          turnStarts.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, turn: Number(data.turn) || turnsSeen });
          break;
        }
        case "turn/end": {
          const reason = data.reason || {};
          const kind = String(reason.kind || "completed");
          turnEnds.push({
            seq: event.seq,
            time: event.time,
            turn: Number(data.turn) || 0,
            kind,
            error: reason.error ? String(reason.error.message || reason.error) : null,
          });
          if (kind !== "completed") {
            errors.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, source: "turn", text: reason.error?.message || `turn ${kind}` });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "session/title": {
          const candidate = typeof data.title === "string" ? data.title.trim() : "";
          const source = data.source?.kind;
          // prefer provider/LLM titles, fall back to any title
          if (candidate && (source === "provider" || !title || titleSource !== "provider")) {
            title = candidate;
            titleSource = source || "event";
          }
          break;
        }
        case "deliverables/presented": {
          const files = Array.isArray(data.files) ? data.files : [];
          if (files.length) {
            deliverables.push({
              cwd: workingDirectory,
              seq: event.seq,
              time: event.time,
              files: files
                .filter((file) => file && file.path)
                .map((file) => ({ path: String(file.path), description: clip(file.description || "", 120) })),
            });
          }
          break;
        }
        case "workspace/changes": {
          workspaceChanges.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, turn: Number(data.turn) || 0 });
          break;
        }
        case "system/message": {
          const text = textOfContent(data.message?.content);
          if (text) systemNotices.push({ seq: event.seq, time: event.time, text });
          break;
        }
        default:
          break;
      }
    }

    const toolCalls = [...toolCallsById.values()].sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    // seq → wall-clock time, used to enrich LLM evidence citations (which only
    // know seq numbers) when mapping into the task model.
    const timeBySeq = new Map();
    for (const list of [
      users,
      signals,
      timeBySeq,
      assistants,
      toolCalls,
      toolResults,
      todoSnapshots,
      turnStarts,
      turnEnds,
      deliverables,
      workspaceChanges,
      errors,
    ]) {
      for (const item of list) if (!timeBySeq.has(item.seq)) timeBySeq.set(item.seq, item.time);
    }
    const parentSession = typeof sessionInfo.parentSession === "string" ? sessionInfo.parentSession : meta.parentSession;
    const delegationDepth = Number.isFinite(sessionInfo.delegationDepth)
      ? Number(sessionInfo.delegationDepth)
      : parentSession
        ? Math.max(1, meta.delegationDepth || 1)
        : 0;
    const createdAt = Number(sessionInfo.createdAt) || meta.createdAt || (events[0]?.time ?? 0);
    const cwd = typeof sessionInfo.cwd === "string" ? sessionInfo.cwd : meta.cwd;
    // Prefer the latest usable session/title event. The discovery / projcache
    // title (meta.title) is often an early placeholder such as "会话 ab12cd"
    // and must only fill in when the log has no readable title. Do not pass the
    // first user message as a fallback to readableTitle(event): an empty or
    // path-like event would otherwise swallow a good metadata title.
    const fromEvent = title ? readableTitle(title) : "";
    if (!fromEvent) titleSource = null;
    const resolvedTitle =
      fromEvent ||
      readableTitle(meta.title, users[0]?.text) ||
      t("会话 {0}", [meta.id.slice(-6)]);
    const lastTurnEnd = turnEnds[turnEnds.length - 1] || null;
    const hasOpenTurn = (turnStarts.at(-1)?.seq || 0) > Math.max(lastTurnEnd?.seq || 0, lastSeedSeq);
    const isLive = sessionLiveness({ ...meta, lastActivityAt, hasOpenTurn });

    return {
      id: meta.id,
      file: meta.file,
      dir: meta.dir,
      sig: meta.sig,
      sigKey: meta.sigKey,
      origin: delegationDepth > 0 ? "subagent" : "main",
      parentSession,
      delegationDepth,
      session: {
        id: sessionInfo.id || meta.id,
        createdAt,
        cwd: cwd || null,
        origin: sessionInfo.origin || (delegationDepth > 0 ? "subagent" : "main"),
        agentPreset: sessionInfo.agentPreset || null,
      },
      title: resolvedTitle,
      titleSource,
      goal: {
        text: typeof meta.goalText === "string" && meta.goalText.trim() ? clip(meta.goalText.trim(), 160) : null,
        status: meta.goalStatus === "done" ? "done" : meta.goalStatus ? "active" : null,
      },
      users,
      signals,
      timeBySeq,
      assistants,
      toolCalls,
      toolResults,
      todoSnapshots,
      turnEnds,
      turnStarts,
      deliverables,
      workspaceChanges,
      errors,
      systemNotices,
      activity,
      lastActivityAt,
      lastEvent: lastEvent ? { type: lastEvent.type, seq: lastEvent.seq, time: lastEvent.time } : null,
      lastAssistantText,
      lastTurnEnd,
      turnCount: Math.max(turnStarts.length, turnEnds.length),
      turnOutline: Array.isArray(meta.turnOutline) ? meta.turnOutline : [],
      assistantMessageCount: assistantTexts,
      eventCount: events.length,
      isLive,
      hasOpenTurn,
      diagnostics,
    };
  }

  function countImages(content) {
    if (!Array.isArray(content)) return 0;
    return content.filter((item) => item && item.type === "image").length;
  }

  /** Compact meta persisted in sessions-cache.json (no event payloads). */
  function metaFromParsed(parsed) {
    const lastTodoSnapshot = parsed.todoSnapshots[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1] || null;
    const todoCounts = { total: 0, completed: 0, pending: 0, inProgress: 0 };
    if (lastTodoSnapshot) {
      todoCounts.total = lastTodoSnapshot.todos.length;
      for (const todo of lastTodoSnapshot.todos) {
        if (todo.status === "completed") todoCounts.completed += 1;
        else if (todo.status === "in_progress") todoCounts.inProgress += 1;
        else todoCounts.pending += 1;
      }
    }
    return {
      id: parsed.id,
      file: parsed.file,
      dir: parsed.dir,
      sig: parsed.sig,
      sigKey: parsed.sigKey,
      title: parsed.title,
      titleSource: parsed.titleSource,
      createdAt: parsed.session.createdAt,
      cwd: parsed.session.cwd,
      parentSession: parsed.parentSession,
      delegationDepth: parsed.delegationDepth,
      origin: parsed.origin,
      lastActivityAt: parsed.lastActivityAt,
      eventCount: parsed.eventCount,
      turnCount: parsed.turnCount,
      isLive: parsed.isLive,
      hasOpenTurn: parsed.hasOpenTurn,
      lastEventType: parsed.lastEvent?.type || null,
      lastEventSeq: parsed.lastEvent?.seq ?? 0,
      lastTurnEnd: parsed.lastTurnEnd,
      userCount: parsed.users.length,
      hasUserMessages: parsed.users.length > 0,
      signalCount: parsed.signals.length,
      deliverableCount: parsed.deliverables.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.files.length, 0),
      errorCount: parsed.errors.length,
      todoCounts,
      lastTodoSeq: lastTodoSnapshot?.seq ?? null,
      lastTurnStartSeq: parsed.turnStarts[parsed.turnStarts.length - 1]?.seq ?? 0,
      goalText: parsed.goal?.text || null,
      goalStatus: parsed.goal?.status || null,
      activity: parsed.activity,
      recentWrites: recentWritesOf(parsed, Date.now()),
      parsedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  /* ------------------------------ digest ---------------------------- */

  function toolCallLabel(call) {
    const name = call.name;
    const args = parseToolArgs(call);
    const description = args.description || args.command || args.code || args.path || args.query || "";
    const compact = String(description).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    return `${name}(${clip(compact, 90)})`;
  }

  /* --------------------------- evidence ---------------------------- */

  const EVIDENCE_LIMIT = 8;
  const QUOTE_LIMIT = 160;

  /**
   * Traceable evidence candidates, ranked by signal value then capped at 40.
   * `sessionId`/`sessionTitle`/`seq`/`time` always point back to the real log.
   */
  function collectEvidence(parsed, { limit = EVIDENCE_LIMIT } = {}) {
    const sessionId = parsed.id;
    const sessionTitle = parsed.title;
    /** @type {Array<{priority:number, order:number, kind:string, text:string, quote:string, seq:number, time:number}>} */
    const candidates = [];
    const push = (priority, order, kind, text, quote, seq, time) => {
      candidates.push({ priority, order, kind, text: clip(String(text || ""), 220), quote: clip(String(quote || text || ""), QUOTE_LIMIT), seq, time: time || 0 });
    };

    const firstUser = parsed.users[0];
    if (firstUser) {
      push(100, 0, "user", t("用户提出初始需求"), firstUser.text, firstUser.seq, firstUser.time);
    }
    const lastUser = parsed.users[parsed.users.length - 1];
    if (lastUser && lastUser !== firstUser) {
      push(80, 1, "user", t("用户最新指令"), lastUser.text, lastUser.seq, lastUser.time);
    }

    parsed.deliverables.forEach((item, index) => {
      const names = item.files.map((file) => path.basename(file.path)).join("、");
      const descriptions = item.files
        .map((file) => file.description)
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join("；");
      push(98, 10 + index, "deliverable", t("交付物：{0}", [clip(names, 160)]), descriptions || item.files.map((file) => file.path).join("\n"), item.seq, item.time);
    });

    parsed.workspaceChanges.forEach((change, index) => {
      push(60, 20 + index, "artifact", t("第 {0} 轮产生了工作区文件变更", [change.turn || "?"]), "", change.seq, change.time);
    });

    const lastAssistant = parsed.lastAssistantText;
    if (lastAssistant) {
      push(90, 30, "assistant", t("助手最新总结"), lastAssistant.text, lastAssistant.seq, lastAssistant.time);
    }
    const finalAssistant = [...parsed.assistants].reverse().find((message) => message.seq < (parsed.lastTurnEnd?.seq ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER));
    if (finalAssistant && finalAssistant !== lastAssistant) {
      push(70, 31, "assistant", t("上一轮完成时的答复"), finalAssistant.text, finalAssistant.seq, finalAssistant.time);
    }

    parsed.errors.slice(-6).forEach((error, index) => {
      push(92, 40 + index, "error", t("错误：{0}", [clip(error.text.replace(/\s+/g, " "), 140)]), error.text, error.seq, error.time);
    });

    const lastTodos = parsed.todoSnapshots[parsed.todoSnapshots.length - 1];
    if (lastTodos) {
      const summary = lastTodos.todos
        .slice(0, 12)
        .map((todo) => `${todo.status === "completed" ? "[x]" : todo.status === "in_progress" ? "[~]" : "[ ]"} ${todo.content}`)
        .join("\n");
      const done = lastTodos.todos.filter((todo) => todo.status === "completed").length;
      push(88, 50, "todo", t("待办进度 {0}/{1}", [done, lastTodos.todos.length]), summary, lastTodos.seq, lastTodos.time);
    }

    const interestingCalls = parsed.toolCalls.filter((call) =>
      ["write", "edit", "present", "bash", "run_code"].includes(call.name),
    );
    interestingCalls.slice(-10).forEach((call, index) => {
      const label = toolCallLabel(call);
      push(50, 60 + index, "tool", t("工具：{0}", [label]), label, call.seq, call.time);
    });

    const olderUsers = parsed.users.slice(Math.max(0, parsed.users.length - 8), -1);
    olderUsers.forEach((message, index) => {
      push(55, 80 + index, "user", t("用户反馈"), message.text, message.seq, message.time);
    });

    parsed.assistants.slice(-5).forEach((message, index) => {
      push(45, 100 + index, "assistant", t("助手进展"), message.text, message.seq, message.time);
    });

    // Rank, dedupe by (kind,seq), then present in timeline order.
    candidates.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || b.seq - a.seq);
    const seen = new Set();
    const chosen = [];
    for (const candidate of candidates) {
      const key = `${candidate.kind}:${candidate.seq}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      chosen.push(candidate);
      if (chosen.length >= limit) break;
    }
    chosen.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
    return chosen.map((candidate) => ({
      id: `e_${shortHash(`${sessionId}:${candidate.kind}:${candidate.seq}`)}`,
      kind: candidate.kind,
      text: candidate.text,
      quote: candidate.quote,
      seq: candidate.seq,
      time: candidate.time,
      sessionId,
      sessionTitle,
    }));
  }

  /* --------------------------- API events -------------------------- */

  const API_KINDS = new Set(["user", "assistant", "todo", "tool", "error", "deliverable"]);

  /** Convert parsed events to the GET /session contract event list. */
  function readApiEvents(parsed, { after = null, limit = 200 } = {}) {
    const events = [];
    const push = (event) => {
      if (!API_KINDS.has(event.kind)) return;
      events.push(event);
    };
    const toolNames = new Map();
    for (const call of parsed.toolCalls) if (call.callId) toolNames.set(call.callId, call.name);

    for (const message of parsed.users) {
      push({ seq: message.seq, time: message.time, kind: "user", role: "user", text: clip(message.text, 2000), toolName: null, todos: null, isError: false });
    }
    for (const message of parsed.assistants) {
      push({ seq: message.seq, time: message.time, kind: "assistant", role: "assistant", text: clip(message.text, 2000), toolName: null, todos: null, isError: false });
    }
    for (const call of parsed.toolCalls) {
      push({
        seq: call.seq,
        time: call.time,
        kind: "tool",
        role: "assistant",
        text: clip(toolCallLabel(call), 2000),
        toolName: call.name,
        todos: null,
        isError: false,
      });
    }
    for (const result of parsed.toolResults) {
      push({
        seq: result.seq,
        time: result.time,
        kind: result.isError ? "error" : "tool",
        role: "tool",
        text: clip(result.text, 2000),
        toolName: result.toolCallId ? toolNames.get(result.toolCallId) || null : null,
        todos: null,
        isError: result.isError,
      });
    }
    for (const snapshot of parsed.todoSnapshots) {
      push({
        seq: snapshot.seq,
        time: snapshot.time,
        kind: "todo",
        role: "system",
        text: snapshot.todos.map((todo) => `${todo.status === "completed" ? "[x]" : todo.status === "in_progress" ? "[~]" : "[ ]"} ${todo.content}`).join("\n"),
        toolName: null,
        todos: snapshot.todos,
        isError: false,
      });
    }
    for (const item of parsed.deliverables) {
      push({
        seq: item.seq,
        time: item.time,
        kind: "deliverable",
        role: "system",
        text: item.files.map((file) => `${file.path}${file.description ? ` —— ${file.description}` : ""}`).join("\n"),
        toolName: null,
        todos: null,
        isError: false,
      });
    }
    for (const end of parsed.turnEnds) {
      if (end.kind === "completed") continue;
      push({
        seq: end.seq,
        time: end.time,
        kind: "error",
        role: "system",
        text: clip(t("本轮{0}：{1}", [end.kind === "error" ? t("失败") : t("中止"), end.error || end.kind]), 2000),
        toolName: null,
        todos: null,
        isError: true,
      });
    }

    events.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq || a.time - b.time);
    // Sanitize the paging window: a non-numeric ?limit= must not disable the cap.
    const capped = Number.isFinite(limit) ? Math.min(Math.max(1, Math.floor(limit)), 500) : 200;
    if (after !== null && Number.isFinite(after)) {
      return events.filter((event) => event.seq > after).slice(0, capped);
    }
    return events.slice(-capped);
  }

  return {
    discover,
    readWorkspaceRegistry,
    loadParsed,
    sessionLiveness,
    metaFromParsed,
    buildDigest,
    collectEvidence,
    readApiEvents,
    extractArtifacts,
    extractSubtasks,
    latestTodos,
    toolBrief,
    parseJsonlEvents,
    decompressSessionBuffer,
    sessionsRoot,
    registryPath: path.join(home, "storages", "workspace.json"),
  };
}

export function normalizeAiRoutePair(settings) {

/**
 * The user's local calendar day as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
 * The AI daily budget and the "今日" counters must follow the user's day, not
 * the UTC day (they disagree near midnight for every non-UTC timezone).
 */
export function todayKey(now = Date.now()) {
  const date = new Date(now);
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

export function emptyUsage() {

    tokens: 0,
    lastScan: { calls: 0, tokens: 0, durationMs: 0, digestBytesAvg: 0 },
  };
}

/** Roll the daily counters over at the user's local midnight. */
export function rolloverUsage(usage, now = Date.now()) {
  const base = usage && typeof usage === "object" ? usage : emptyUsage();
  const date = todayKey(now);
  if (base.date !== date) {
    return {
      date,
      calls: 0,
      budgetUsed: 0,
      tokens: 0,
      lastScan: { calls: 0, tokens: 0, durationMs: 0, digestBytesAvg: 0 },
    };
  }
  return {
    date,
    calls: Math.max(0, Number(base.calls) || 0),
    budgetUsed: Math.max(0, Number(base.calls) || 0, Number(base.budgetUsed) || 0),
    tokens: Math.max(0, Number(base.tokens) || 0),
    lastScan: {
      calls: Math.max(0, Number(base.lastScan?.calls) || 0),
      tokens: Math.max(0, Number(base.lastScan?.tokens) || 0),
      durationMs: Math.max(0, Number(base.lastScan?.durationMs) || 0),
      digestBytesAvg: Math.max(0, Number(base.lastScan?.digestBytesAvg) || 0),
    },
  };
}

let manualCounter = 0;

export function shortId(prefix, seed) {

export function pushHistory(task, entry, limit = HISTORY_LIMIT) {
  if (!task || !entry) return;
  task.history = Array.isArray(task.history) ? task.history : [];
  task.history.push({ at: new Date().toISOString(), by: "ai", ...entry });
  if (task.history.length > limit) task.history = task.history.slice(-limit);
}

function clipText(value, max) {
  const text = typeof value === "string" ? value : String(value ?? "");
  return text.length > max ? `${text.slice(0, Math.max(0, max - 1))}…` : text;
}

/** Positive integer sequence number, or null when absent/invalid (never 0). */
export function positiveSeqOrNull(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0 ? Math.floor(number) : null;
}

/**
 * A queued "this turn ended, approve it" notice pinned to the floating entry.
 * Only the last turn matters, so a task carries at most one. Invalid records are
 * dropped instead of being partly persisted.
 */
export function normalizeTaskReview(value) {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return null;
  const sessionId = typeof value.sessionId === "string" ? value.sessionId.trim().slice(0, 200) : "";
  const at = Number(value.at);
  if (!sessionId || !Number.isFinite(at) || at <= 0) return null;
  return {
    at: Math.floor(at),
    sessionId,
    seq: positiveSeqOrNull(value.seq) || 0,
    kind: REVIEW_KINDS.has(value.kind) ? value.kind : "completed",
  };
}

/** Bounded ledger of the last turn-end seq already considered per session. */
export function normalizeReviewSeen(value) {
  const result = {};
  if (!isRecord(value)) return result;
  // Keep the newest entries: the service deletes the oldest ones first.
  const entries = Object.entries(value);
  for (const [id, seq] of entries.slice(Math.max(0, entries.length - REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT))) {
    if (typeof id !== "string" || !id || id.length > 200) continue;
    const number = Number(seq);
    if (Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0) result[id] = Math.floor(number);
  }
  return result;
}

/** Bounded map of sessions whose provisional review was dismissed, to a timestamp. */
export function normalizeReviewDeferred(value) {
  const result = {};
  if (!isRecord(value)) return result;
  const entries = Object.entries(value);
  for (const [id, flag] of entries.slice(Math.max(0, entries.length - REVIEW_SEEN_LIMIT))) {
    if (typeof id !== "string" || !id || id.length > 200) continue;
    const number = Number(flag);
    if (Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0) result[id] = Math.floor(number);
  }
  return result;
}

/** Sanitize one issue entry (objects from the analyzer, strings via the API). */
export function normalizeIssueRecord(item) {
  if (typeof item === "string") {
    const text = clipText(item, ISSUE_TEXT_LIMIT);
    return text ? { text, severity: "medium", sessionId: null, seq: null } : null;
  }
  if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) return null;
  const text = clipText(typeof item.text === "string" ? item.text : "", ISSUE_TEXT_LIMIT);
  if (!text) return null;
  const record = {
    text,
    severity: ["high", "medium", "low"].includes(item.severity) ? item.severity : "medium",
    sessionId: typeof item.sessionId === "string" ? item.sessionId : null,
    seq: positiveSeqOrNull(item.seq),
  };
  if (typeof item.id === "string" && item.id) record.id = item.id;
  if (item.source === "manual") record.source = "manual";
  return record;
}

/** Sanitize one milestone entry (v1 field still surfaced by the client). */
export function normalizeMilestoneRecord(item) {
  if (typeof item === "string") {
    const text = clipText(item, MILESTONE_TEXT_LIMIT);
    return text ? { text, done: false, sessionId: null, seq: null } : null;
  }
  if (!item || typeof item !== "object" || Array.isArray(item)) return null;
  const text = clipText(typeof item.text === "string" ? item.text : "", MILESTONE_TEXT_LIMIT);
  if (!text) return null;
  const record = {
    text,
    done: item.done === true,
    sessionId: typeof item.sessionId === "string" ? item.sessionId : null,
    seq: positiveSeqOrNull(item.seq),
  };
  if (typeof item.id === "string" && item.id) record.id = item.id;
  return record;
}

/** Keep task payloads bounded before persisting/serving them (v2 caps). */
export function truncateTask(task, projectIds) {
  if (!task) return task;
  normalizeTaskPlanning(task, projectIds);
  if (Array.isArray(task.evidence)) {
    task.evidence = task.evidence
      .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object")
      .slice(0, EVIDENCE_LIMIT)
      .map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        text: clipText(item.text, EVIDENCE_TEXT_LIMIT),
        quote: clipText(item.quote, EVIDENCE_QUOTE_LIMIT),
      }));
  } else {
    task.evidence = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.keyFacts)) {
    task.keyFacts = task.keyFacts
      .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object")
      .slice(0, KEYFACT_LIMIT)
      .map((item) => ({ ...item, text: clipText(item.text, KEYFACT_TEXT_LIMIT) }));
  } else {
    task.keyFacts = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.subtasks)) {
    const items = task.subtasks.filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object");
    task.subtasks = [
      ...items.filter((item) => item.source === "manual").slice(0, MANUAL_SUBTASK_LIMIT),
      ...items.filter((item) => item.source !== "manual").slice(0, SUBTASK_LIMIT),
    ]
      .map((item) => ({ ...item, text: clipText(item.text, SUBTASK_TEXT_LIMIT) }));
  } else {
    task.subtasks = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.artifacts)) {
    task.artifacts = task.artifacts
      .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object")
      .slice(0, ARTIFACT_LIMIT)
      .map((item) => ({ ...item, name: clipText(item.name, ARTIFACT_NAME_LIMIT) }));
  } else {
    task.artifacts = [];
  }
  task.history = Array.isArray(task.history) ? task.history.filter(isRecord).slice(-HISTORY_LIMIT) : [];
  if (!Array.isArray(task.lockedFields)) task.lockedFields = [];
  if (Array.isArray(task.tags)) {
    task.tags = task.tags
      .filter((tag) => typeof tag === "string")
      .slice(0, TAG_LIMIT)
      .map((tag) => clipText(tag, TAG_TEXT_LIMIT));
  } else {
    task.tags = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.issues)) {
    // Filter invalid entries before applying the cap, so junk cannot push real
    // entries out of the persisted list.
    task.issues = task.issues.map(normalizeIssueRecord).filter(Boolean).slice(0, ISSUE_LIMIT);
  } else {
    task.issues = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.nextSteps)) {
    task.nextSteps = task.nextSteps
      .map((step) => clipText(typeof step === "string" ? step : step?.text, NEXTSTEP_TEXT_LIMIT))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .slice(0, NEXTSTEP_LIMIT);
  } else {
    task.nextSteps = [];
  }
  if (Array.isArray(task.milestones)) {
    task.milestones = task.milestones.map(normalizeMilestoneRecord).filter(Boolean).slice(0, MILESTONE_LIMIT);
  } else {
    task.milestones = [];
  }
  task.sessions = Array.isArray(task.sessions)
    ? task.sessions.filter((session) => isRecord(session) && typeof session.id === "string" && session.id)
    : [];
  task.relations = normalizeRelations(task.relations, task.id);
  task.resolvedIssues = Array.isArray(task.resolvedIssues) ? task.resolvedIssues.filter((item) => typeof item === "string").slice(-50) : [];
  if (typeof task.title === "string") task.title = clipText(task.title, TITLE_TEXT_LIMIT);
  task.acceptanceCriteria = clipText(typeof task.acceptanceCriteria === "string" ? task.acceptanceCriteria.trim() : "", ACCEPTANCE_TEXT_LIMIT);
  if (isRecord(task.goal)) {
    task.goal.text = clipText(task.goal.text, GOAL_TEXT_LIMIT);
    if (!["active", "done", "none"].includes(task.goal.status)) task.goal.status = task.goal.text ? "active" : "none";
    if (!["session", "task"].includes(task.goal.source)) task.goal.source = "task";
  } else {
    const text = typeof task.goal === "string" ? task.goal : "";
    task.goal = { text: clipText(text, GOAL_TEXT_LIMIT), status: text ? "active" : "none", source: "task" };
  }
  if (!isRecord(task.sessionContext)) task.sessionContext = null;
  task.review = normalizeTaskReview(task.review);
  return task;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* v1 → v2 migration                                                   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

function migrateTaskV1V2(task) {
  if (!task || typeof task !== "object") return task;
  const sessions = Array.isArray(task.sessions) ? task.sessions : [];
  const firstSession = sessions[0] || null;
  const evidence = (Array.isArray(task.evidence) ? task.evidence : []).slice(0, EVIDENCE_LIMIT).map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    quote: clipText(item?.quote || item?.text, EVIDENCE_QUOTE_LIMIT),
  }));
  const keyFacts = evidence.slice(0, 3).map((item, index) => ({
    id: shortId("k", `mig:${task.id}:${index}`),
    text: clipText(item?.text || item?.quote, KEYFACT_TEXT_LIMIT),
    kind: item?.kind === "error" ? "issue" : item?.kind === "deliverable" || item?.kind === "artifact" ? "artifact" : "status",
    sessionId: item?.sessionId || firstSession?.id || null,
    seq: Number(item?.seq) || 0,
  }));
  const subtasks = (Array.isArray(task.milestones) ? task.milestones : []).slice(0, SUBTASK_LIMIT).map((milestone, index) => ({
    id: shortId("s", `mig:${task.id}:${index}`),
    text: clipText(milestone?.text, SUBTASK_TEXT_LIMIT),
    done: milestone?.done === true,
    source: "manual",
    seq: Number(milestone?.seq) || 0,
  }));
  const goalText = clipText(typeof task.goal === "string" ? task.goal : task.goal?.text || "", GOAL_TEXT_LIMIT);
  return {
    ...task,
    title: clipText(task.title, TITLE_TEXT_LIMIT),
    goal: {
      text: goalText,
      status: goalText ? (task.status === "done" ? "done" : "active") : "none",
      source: "task",
    },
    keyFacts,
    subtasks,
    artifacts: [],
    sessionContext: firstSession
      ? {
          sessionId: firstSession.id,
          title: firstSession.title || "",
          isLive: false,
          turnCount: 0,
          lastTurnEnd: null,
          lastActivityAt: Number(task.lastActivityAt) || 0,
          todoTotal: 0,
          todoDone: 0,
        }
      : null,
    evidence,
    history: (Array.isArray(task.history) ? task.history : []).slice(-HISTORY_LIMIT),
    lockedFields: Array.isArray(task.lockedFields) ? task.lockedFields : [],
  };
}

/** True for JSON objects (arrays/null excluded). */
function isRecord(value) {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** Task records from untrusted JSON; non-objects are dropped, not crashed on. */
function taskList(value) {
  return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).filter(isRecord);
}

/** String list from untrusted JSON (ids are opaque strings). */
function stringList(value) {
  return (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []).filter((item) => typeof item === "string");
}

function migrateStateV1V2(raw) {
  const state = createEmptyState();
  state.tasks = taskList(raw.tasks).map((task) => truncateTask(migrateTaskV1V2(task)));
  if (isRecord(raw.settings)) {
    state.settings = normalizeAiRoutePair({
      ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
      ...normalizeSettingsPatch(raw.settings),
      lastScanAt: raw.settings.lastScanAt || null,
    });
  }
  if (Array.isArray(raw.ignoredSessions)) state.ignoredSessions = stringList(raw.ignoredSessions);
  if (Array.isArray(raw.suppressedSessions)) state.suppressedSessions = stringList(raw.suppressedSessions);
  if (Array.isArray(raw.deletedLog)) state.deletedLog = raw.deletedLog.filter(isRecord);
  if (Array.isArray(raw.workspaces)) state.workspaces = raw.workspaces.filter(isRecord);
  if (Array.isArray(raw.activity)) state.activity = raw.activity.filter(isRecord);
  if (isRecord(raw.scan)) state.scan = { ...emptyScanState(), ...raw.scan };
  state.usage = rolloverUsage(raw.usage);
  return state;
}

/** Coerce arbitrary settings patches into the contract shape + valid ranges. */
export function normalizeSettingsPatch(patch) {
  const result = {};
  if (!patch || typeof patch !== "object") return result;
  if (typeof patch.autoScan === "boolean") result.autoScan = patch.autoScan;
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(patch.scanIntervalSeconds))) {
    result.scanIntervalSeconds = Math.min(3600, Math.max(30, Math.round(Number(patch.scanIntervalSeconds))));
  }
  if (typeof patch.aiEnabled === "boolean") result.aiEnabled = patch.aiEnabled;
  if (typeof patch.model === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(patch.model.trim())) {
    result.model = patch.model.trim();
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(patch.initialDays))) {
    result.initialDays = Math.min(365, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(patch.initialDays))));
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(patch.maxTasksPerSession))) {
    result.maxTasksPerSession = Math.min(10, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(patch.maxTasksPerSession))));
  }
  if (Array.isArray(patch.excludeWorkspaces)) {
    result.excludeWorkspaces = [...new Set(patch.excludeWorkspaces.filter((id) => typeof id === "string"))].slice(0, 100);
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(patch.maxAiCallsPerScan))) {
    result.maxAiCallsPerScan = Math.min(
      AI_CALLS_PER_SCAN_MAX,
      Math.max(AI_CALLS_PER_SCAN_MIN, Math.round(Number(patch.maxAiCallsPerScan))),
    );
  }
  if (typeof patch.aiProvider === "string") {
    const value = patch.aiProvider.trim();
    if (AI_PROVIDER_RE.test(value)) result.aiProvider = value;
  }
  if (typeof patch.aiModel === "string") {
    const value = patch.aiModel.trim();
    if (AI_MODEL_RE.test(value)) result.aiModel = value;
  }
  if (patch.aiBudgetMode === "auto" || patch.aiBudgetMode === "fixed") {
    result.aiBudgetMode = patch.aiBudgetMode;
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(patch.dailyAiCallLimit))) {
    result.dailyAiCallLimit = Math.min(500, Math.max(10, Math.round(Number(patch.dailyAiCallLimit))));
  }
  return result;
}

export function createStore({ dshHome, logger } = {}) {
  if (!dshHome) throw new Error("createStore requires dshHome");
  const dir = path.join(dshHome, "storages", "super-kanban");
  const backupsDir = path.join(dir, "backups");
  const stateFile = path.join(dir, "state.json");
  const cacheFile = path.join(dir, "sessions-cache.json");
  const log = logger || console;

  function ensureDirs() {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(backupsDir, { recursive: true });
  }

  function backupCorrupt(file, error, label = "corrupt") {
    try {
      ensureDirs();
      const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
      const target = path.join(backupsDir, `${path.basename(file)}.${stamp}.${label}`);
      fs.renameSync(file, target);
      log.warn?.(`[super-kanban] store file moved to ${target}: ${String(error?.message || error)}`);
      const backups = fs
        .readdirSync(backupsDir)
        .filter((name) => /\.(corrupt|v1|migrate-failed)$/.test(name))
        .sort();
      for (const name of backups.slice(0, Math.max(0, backups.length - BACKUP_KEEP))) {
        try {
          fs.unlinkSync(path.join(backupsDir, name));
        } catch {
          /* ignore */
        }
      }
    } catch (backupError) {
      log.warn?.(`[super-kanban] could not back up ${file}: ${String(backupError?.message || backupError)}`);
    }
  }

  function copyToBackup(file, label = "v1") {
    try {
      ensureDirs();
      const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
      fs.copyFileSync(file, path.join(backupsDir, `${path.basename(file)}.${stamp}.${label}`));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function readJson(file, fallback, { allowBackup = true } = {}) {
    try {
      const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
      const data = JSON.parse(text);
      if (!data || typeof data !== "object") throw new Error("not-an-object");
      return { data, error: null };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error?.code === "ENOENT") return { data: fallback, error: null, missing: true };
      if (allowBackup) backupCorrupt(file, error);
      return { data: fallback, error };
    }
  }

  /** Atomic write: JSON.stringify → tmp file → rename over the target. */
  function writeJson(file, data) {
    ensureDirs();
    const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`;
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(data), "utf8");
      fs.renameSync(tmp, file);
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(tmp);
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  function load() {
    const diagnostics = [];
    const stateRead = readJson(stateFile, null);
    if (stateRead.error) diagnostics.push({ kind: "state", message: String(stateRead.error.message || stateRead.error) });
    const cacheRead = readJson(cacheFile, null);
    if (cacheRead.error) diagnostics.push({ kind: "cache", message: String(cacheRead.error.message || cacheRead.error) });

    let state = createEmptyState();
    if (stateRead.data) {
      const version = Number(stateRead.data.version) || 1;
      try {
        if (version >= STORE_VERSION) {
          state = createEmptyState();
          copyFields(state, stateRead.data);
        } else {
          // Keep a pristine copy of the v1 document before rewriting it.
          copyToBackup(stateFile, "v1");
          state = migrateStateV1V2(stateRead.data);
          diagnostics.push({ kind: "migrate", message: t("state v{0} → v{1}（任务 {2} 个）", [version, STORE_VERSION, state.tasks.length]) });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Migration must never brick the board: back up and rebuild.
        backupCorrupt(stateFile, error, "migrate-failed");
        state = createEmptyState();
        diagnostics.push({ kind: "migrate", message: t("迁移失败，已备份并重建：{0}", [String(error?.message || error)]) });
      }
      // A scan that was "running" when the process died can never finish.
      if (state.scan && state.scan.state === "running") {
        state.scan.state = "idle";
        state.scan.finishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        state.scan.message = t("上次扫描未完成（进程重启）");
      }
    }
    state.usage = rolloverUsage(state.usage);
    for (const task of state.tasks) truncateTask(task);

    const cache = createEmptyCache();
    if (cacheRead.data) {
      if (isRecord(cacheRead.data.sessions)) {
        for (const [id, entry] of Object.entries(cacheRead.data.sessions)) {
          // Only entries the scanner can actually consume: a corrupt cache must
          // degrade to "scan this session again", never crash the scan.
          if (isRecord(entry) && isRecord(entry.meta)) cache.sessions[id] = entry;
        }
      }
      if (typeof cacheRead.data.updatedAt === "string") cache.updatedAt = cacheRead.data.updatedAt;
      const cacheVersion = Number(cacheRead.data.version) || 1;
      if (cacheVersion < STORE_VERSION) {
        // v2 gate markers did not exist in v1: clear them so the first v2 scan
        // re-judges each session once (necessary to populate v2 fields).
        for (const entry of Object.values(cache.sessions)) {
          const meta = entry?.meta;
          if (!meta || typeof meta !== "object") continue;
          delete meta.aiAt;
          delete meta.aiLastSeq;
          delete meta.aiUserCount;
          delete meta.aiTurnEndKind;
          delete meta.aiDigestBytes;
          delete meta.llmError;
        }
        diagnostics.push({ kind: "migrate", message: t("sessions-cache v{0} → v{1}（AI 门控标记已重置，首扫将重新研判）", [cacheVersion, STORE_VERSION]) });
      }
    }
    return { state, cache, diagnostics };
  }

  function copyFields(target, raw, projects = normalizeProjects(raw.projects)) {
    // Hand-edited/partially corrupted JSON must never crash the board later:
    // keep only records with the shape the rest of the service assumes.
    target.tasks = taskList(raw.tasks);
    target.projects = projects;
    if (isRecord(raw.settings)) {
      target.settings = normalizeAiRoutePair({
        ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
        ...normalizeSettingsPatch(raw.settings),
        lastScanAt: raw.settings.lastScanAt || null,
      });
    }
    if (Array.isArray(raw.ignoredSessions)) target.ignoredSessions = stringList(raw.ignoredSessions);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.suppressedSessions)) target.suppressedSessions = stringList(raw.suppressedSessions);
    if (isRecord(raw.reviewSeen)) target.reviewSeen = normalizeReviewSeen(raw.reviewSeen);
    if (isRecord(raw.reviewDeferred)) target.reviewDeferred = normalizeReviewDeferred(raw.reviewDeferred);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.deletedLog)) target.deletedLog = raw.deletedLog.filter(isRecord);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.workspaces)) target.workspaces = raw.workspaces.filter(isRecord);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.activity)) target.activity = raw.activity.filter(isRecord);
    if (isRecord(raw.scan)) target.scan = { ...emptyScanState(), ...raw.scan };
    if (typeof raw.savedAt === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(raw.savedAt))) target.savedAt = raw.savedAt;
    target.usage = rolloverUsage(raw.usage);
    const projectIds = new Set(target.projects.map((project) => project.id));
    for (const task of target.tasks) truncateTask(task, projectIds);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.recovery)) {
      target.recovery = raw.recovery.filter((entry) => isRecord(entry) && recoverableTask(entry.task) &&
        (entry.kind !== "merge" || (recoverableTask(entry.beforeTarget) && typeof entry.targetUpdatedAt === "string"))).slice(-50);
      for (const entry of target.recovery) {
        truncateTask(entry.task, projectIds);
        if (entry.kind === "merge") truncateTask(entry.beforeTarget, projectIds);
      }
    }
  }

  function recoverableTask(task) {
    return isRecord(task) && typeof task.id === "string" && task.id && typeof task.title === "string" && task.title.trim();
  }

  function saveState(state) {
    state.version = STORE_VERSION;
    state.savedAt = new Date(Math.max(Date.now(), (Date.parse(state.savedAt) || 0) + 1)).toISOString();
    state.usage = rolloverUsage(state.usage);
    for (const task of state.tasks) truncateTask(task);
    // Tombstones and ignored lists stay bounded.
    if (state.deletedLog.length > 50) state.deletedLog = state.deletedLog.slice(-50);
    state.recovery = (state.recovery || []).slice(-50);
    if (state.ignoredSessions.length > 500) state.ignoredSessions = state.ignoredSessions.slice(-500);
    if (state.suppressedSessions.length > 500) state.suppressedSessions = state.suppressedSessions.slice(-500);
    writeJson(stateFile, state);
  }

  function saveCache(cache) {
    cache.version = STORE_VERSION;
    cache.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    writeJson(cacheFile, cache);
  }

  function readBackup(raw) {
    if (!isRecord(raw) || raw.version !== STORE_VERSION || !Array.isArray(raw.tasks) || !isRecord(raw.settings)) {
      throw new TypeError(t("请选择当前看板导出的备份文件"));
    }
    const projects = normalizeProjects(raw.projects);
    if (Object.hasOwn(raw, "projects") && (!Array.isArray(raw.projects) || projects.length !== raw.projects.length ||
        projects.some((project, index) => project.workspaceId !== (raw.projects[index].workspaceId || null)))) {
      throw new TypeError(t("备份中有无效项目、重复项目或重复的工作区绑定"));
    }
    const projectIds = new Set(projects.map((project) => project.id));
    const ids = new Set();
    for (const task of raw.tasks) {
      if (!recoverableTask(task) || ids.has(task.id)) {
        throw new TypeError(t("备份中有无效或重复的任务"));
      }
      if (task.projectId != null && task.projectId !== "" && !projectIds.has(task.projectId)) {
        throw new TypeError(t("备份中的任务关联了缺失的项目"));
      }
      ids.add(task.id);
    }
    const restored = createEmptyState();
    copyFields(restored, raw, projects);
    restored.scan = emptyScanState();
    return restored;
  }

  function saveRestorePoint(state) {
    writeJson(path.join(backupsDir, "before-restore.json"), { state });
  }

  return {
    dir,
    stateFile,
    cacheFile,
    backupsDir,
    load,
    saveState,
    saveCache,
    readBackup,
    saveRestorePoint,
    ensureDirs,
    backupCorrupt,
  };
}
